title: Finance Analyst - Collection, Finance
description:
About Voxy


Voxy, established in 2010, is an innovative language training platform designed to address the unique language requirements of global organizations. Aiming to boost productivity, encourage collaboration, and unlock human potential, Voxy has positioned itself as a worldwide leader in corporate language training. Voxy has built a strong foundation and a continually developing vision, assisting corporate clients in 150 nations through live language coaching by certified teachers and a vast selection of role-specific courses that address essential soft and technical skill deficiencies.


Currently, Voxy's influence reaches worldwide, with committed teams working in various locations such as the United States, Brazil, Chile, Mexico, Thailand, Malaysia, Spain, Italy, and Ireland. Initially concentrated on English language teaching, Voxy has expanded to provide various languages, such as Portuguese, Spanish, Italian, German, and French, serving a wide variety of learners.


We think that acquiring a language ought to be enjoyable, fulfilling, and a pathway to the finest experiences life presents. If you’re on board, we would be happy to discuss.


You can find additional information about our values at this link (


The Impact You’ll Have at Voxy

Growth brings complexity. This role exists to ensure our financial operations keep pace, reducing DSO, identifying risks early, and resolving payment issues before they escalate.


What You’ll Be Doing:

Collections & Cash Application:

• Performs daily collection activities on overdue customer accounts through outbound calls, emails, and correspondence following established dunning schedules and escalation protocols.

• Monitors AR aging reports and prioritizes collection efforts based on balance size, days past due, customer risk profile, and strategic account importance.

• Investigates and resolves customer billing disputes by coordinating with Sales, AM/KAM, Billing, and Contract Administration teams; documents dispute details and resolution actions in the XERO/Salesforce system.

• Negotiates payment plans and settlement arrangements with customers within approved parameters; tracks compliance with agreed terms and escalates non-performing arrangements to the FP&A Manager.

• Applies incoming customer payments (checks, ACH, wire transfers) to open invoices in the AR sub-ledger; investigates and resolves unapplied cash, short payments, and overpayments.

• Prepares and sends customer account statements, past-due notices, and collection letters per company dunning policies.

• Processes customer write-offs and bad debt adjustments per approval policies; prepares supporting documentation for bad debt provisions.


Credit Analysis & Risk Management:

• Performs credit reviews for new and existing customers by analyzing financial statements, credit reports, trade references, and payment history; recommends credit limits and payment terms.

• Monitors customer credit exposure and concentration risk; flags accounts exceeding approved credit limits or exhibiting deteriorating payment behavior.

• Maintains accurate customer credit files and ensures compliance with internal credit policies and approval hierarchies.


Reporting & Analysis:

• Prepares weekly and monthly collection status reports, aging summaries, DSO analysis, and cash collection forecasts for management review.

• Tracks and reports on collection KPIs including collection effectiveness index, roll rates, promise-to-pay conversion rates, and bad debt write-off trends.

• Supports month-end AR close activities including revenue accruals, bad debt provisions, credit memo processing, and sub-ledger-to-GL reconciliation.

• Assists with ad-hoc analysis and special projects as directed by the FP&A Manager or Senior FP&A Analyst.


What We’re Looking For:

• B.A/B.S. Degree - Accounting or Business Administration;

• 2+ years accounting and/or finance experience, with prior/current internship in accounting;

• Organized, process-oriented and meticulous attention to details;

• Comfortable working in an entrepreneurial environment and someone who is eager to learn, contribute as a team member and do more and to progress in the company;

• Advanced Excel skills. Experience with macros/VBA is a plus;

• Based anywhere in Brazil

• Capable of writing and reading in both English and Spanish

• Experience with tech company, preferably Enterprise Saas, is a plus.


Job Details:

• Gross Salary: R$110,500/year

• Working Hours: 8:00am - 5:00pm (GMT-3)


In addition to a rewarding job that that will directly impact how millions of students learn English, working here, you’ll enjoy:

• Competitive salary (base/commission/bonus/equity)

• Great benefits: medical insurance, cell phone & wifi reimbursement, home office & wellness budget, team events

• Remote friendly work policies

• Professional development budget

• Language classes w/ Voxy & Fluentify

• Work with an awesome international team of super bright, creative, talented, and passionate individuals based around the world

title: Finance Analyst - Collection, Finance
description:
About Voxy


Voxy, established in 2010, is an innovative language training platform designed to address the unique language requirements of global organizations. Aiming to boost productivity, encourage collaboration, and unlock human potential, Voxy has positioned itself as a worldwide leader in corporate language training. Voxy has built a strong foundation and a continually developing vision, assisting corporate clients in 150 nations through live language coaching by certified teachers and a vast selection of role-specific courses that address essential soft and technical skill deficiencies.


Currently, Voxy's influence reaches worldwide, with committed teams working in various locations such as the United States, Brazil, Chile, Mexico, Thailand, Malaysia, Spain, Italy, and Ireland. Initially concentrated on English language teaching, Voxy has expanded to provide various languages, such as Portuguese, Spanish, Italian, German, and French, serving a wide variety of learners.


We think that acquiring a language ought to be enjoyable, fulfilling, and a pathway to the finest experiences life presents. If you’re on board, we would be happy to discuss.


You can find additional information about our values at this link (


The Impact You’ll Have at Voxy

Growth brings complexity. This role exists to ensure our financial operations keep pace, reducing DSO, identifying risks early, and resolving payment issues before they escalate.


What You’ll Be Doing:

Collections & Cash Application:

• Performs daily collection activities on overdue customer accounts through outbound calls, emails, and correspondence following established dunning schedules and escalation protocols.

• Monitors AR aging reports and prioritizes collection efforts based on balance size, days past due, customer risk profile, and strategic account importance.

• Investigates and resolves customer billing disputes by coordinating with Sales, AM/KAM, Billing, and Contract Administration teams; documents dispute details and resolution actions in the XERO/Salesforce system.

• Negotiates payment plans and settlement arrangements with customers within approved parameters; tracks compliance with agreed terms and escalates non-performing arrangements to the FP&A Manager.

• Applies incoming customer payments (checks, ACH, wire transfers) to open invoices in the AR sub-ledger; investigates and resolves unapplied cash, short payments, and overpayments.

• Prepares and sends customer account statements, past-due notices, and collection letters per company dunning policies.

• Processes customer write-offs and bad debt adjustments per approval policies; prepares supporting documentation for bad debt provisions.


Credit Analysis & Risk Management:

• Performs credit reviews for new and existing customers by analyzing financial statements, credit reports, trade references, and payment history; recommends credit limits and payment terms.

• Monitors customer credit exposure and concentration risk; flags accounts exceeding approved credit limits or exhibiting deteriorating payment behavior.

• Maintains accurate customer credit files and ensures compliance with internal credit policies and approval hierarchies.


Reporting & Analysis:

• Prepares weekly and monthly collection status reports, aging summaries, DSO analysis, and cash collection forecasts for management review.

• Tracks and reports on collection KPIs including collection effectiveness index, roll rates, promise-to-pay conversion rates, and bad debt write-off trends.

• Supports month-end AR close activities including revenue accruals, bad debt provisions, credit memo processing, and sub-ledger-to-GL reconciliation.

• Assists with ad-hoc analysis and special projects as directed by the FP&A Manager or Senior FP&A Analyst.


What We’re Looking For:

• B.A/B.S. Degree - Accounting or Business Administration;

• 2+ years accounting and/or finance experience, with prior/current internship in accounting;

• Organized, process-oriented and meticulous attention to details;

• Comfortable working in an entrepreneurial environment and someone who is eager to learn, contribute as a team member and do more and to progress in the company;

• Advanced Excel skills. Experience with macros/VBA is a plus;

• Based anywhere in Brazil

• Capable of writing and reading in both English and Spanish

• Experience with tech company, preferably Enterprise Saas, is a plus.


Job Details:

• Gross Salary: R$110,500/year

• Working Hours: 8:00am - 5:00pm (GMT-3)


In addition to a rewarding job that that will directly impact how millions of students learn English, working here, you’ll enjoy:

• Competitive salary (base/commission/bonus/equity)

• Great benefits: medical insurance, cell phone & wifi reimbursement, home office & wellness budget, team events

• Remote friendly work policies

• Professional development budget

• Language classes w/ Voxy & Fluentify

• Work with an awesome international team of super bright, creative, talented, and passionate individuals based around the world

title: DevOps Sr
description:
O Inatel está recrutando Especialista para atuar como DevOps, no ICC SOFT.

Responsabilidades e atribuições


  • Realizar a atualização de sistemas (deployment) utilizando tecnologia específica do projeto;
  • Desenvolver scripts de alta complexidade para automatização de deployment do projeto ou qualquer outra tarefa que o projeto julgue necessária sua automatização;
  • Realizar monitoramento de sistemas e aplicações utilizando tecnologia definida no projeto, analisar de a alta complexidade em dados obtidos, e realizar configurações complexas na ferramenta;
  • Definir arquitetura em termos de documentação e tecnologia;
  • Utilizar plataformas de computação em nuvem e provisionar recursos e serviços básicos de cloud, de forma manual e automatizada;
  • Desenvolver ferramentas web de complexidade média para uso interno do projeto;
  • Documentar processos e soluções técnicas de acordo com as necessidades do projeto;
  • Analisar e resolver incidentes críticos de software e infraestrutura no sistema;
  • Realizar automatização de processo de Build;
  • Analisar e isolar o defeito apontado no processo de testes da solução, bem como identificar a causa raiz e propor uma solução a fim de atender aos processos de qualidade de software;
  • Criar documentações complementares de acordo com as necessidades do projeto;
  • Aplicar novos procedimentos de desenvolvimento de software, conforme necessidade, descrevendo métodos e operacionalização dos mesmos, em sequência padronizada, de acordo com o sistema de qualidade assegurada, a fim de buscar melhorias contínuas;
  • Atuar como agente multiplicador de conhecimentos, prestando suporte técnico ao time.


Requisitos e qualificações

Ensino superior completo, preferencialmente em cursos de Computação, Sistemas de Informação ou Ciência da Computação;


Forte compreensão de arquiteturas nativas de nuvem (cloud-native), incluindo Kubernetes, microsserviços e malha de serviços (service mesh);


Domínio em:

  • Ferramentas para deployment (ex: Jenkings, Ansible, Puppet, Chef, Travis CI, Salt),
  • Plataformas de computação em nuvem (ex: AWS, Openstack, Google Cloud),
  • Criação de scripts em Shell Script, Python ou PHP,
  • Automatização de cloud (ex: Terraform, Cloud Formation),
  • Infraestrutura como Código,
  • Linguagem de programação para automatização de testes (ex: Selenium, Javascript, Phanton JS, Casper JS),
  • Ferramentas de controle de versão (Ex.:GIT, Gerrit),
  • Lógica de Programação;


Conhecimentos em:

  • Ferramentas Grafana, Graphite, ELK,
  • Utilização de container Docker, Kubernetes, Gerenciamento de ambiente Linux,
  • Banco de Dados (Ex: SQL Server, MySQL, Cassandra) SQL/NoSQL, consulta e criação de tabelas/esquemas/scripts,
  • Métodos de desenvolvimento de sistemas (Ex: Scrum) e ferramenta de controle (EX: Jira);


Noções sobre Segurança e Vulnerabilidade (Ex. SQL injection, cross-site scripting, CSRF, SSL, etc);


Inglês avançado / fluente para conversação devido contato diário com equipes internacionais.

Informações adicionais

Horário de trabalho : Segunda à sexta-feira, das 8h as 12h e das 13h00 as 17h00.


Local de trabalho : As atividades serão realizadas em regime de Teletrabalho \"Home Office\".

title: Data Engineer/ Data Architect
description:
About the position

The senior-level position will be part of the our client team business intelligence solution that brings data from multiple products onto one platform enabling analysis and data-driven insights.


Responsibilities will focus on designing, building, and maintaining scalable data pipelines and infrastructure that converts raw data into a format ready for ingestion by a BI tool.


The ideal candidate should be able to design data pipelines (not only build them), make architectural decisions, understand data flows end-to-end, and work beyond ticket-based execution.


What You’ll Actually Be Doing

Pipeline Design (not just implementation)

  • Define how pipelines should be built (not only execute them)
  • Design ingestion, transformation (ELT), and delivery strategies
  • Ensure scalability, maintainability, and performance

Data Architecture & Data Flows

  • Understand and design full data flows end-to-end
  • Work with modern data architectures (ELT, distributed systems)
  • Make decisions on data modeling and storage

Cloud-to-Cloud Migrations

  • Work on data migrations across cloud environments
  • Optimize movement and transformation of large datasets
  • Ensure reliability and performance during migrations

Optimization & Performance

  • Optimize SQL queries and data pipelines
  • Improve efficiency and reduce processing costs
  • Identify bottlenecks and propose scalable solutions

Production Troubleshooting (Critical)

  • Investigate issues such as incorrect data in dashboards
  • Trace problems across the full pipeline (ingestion → transformation → BI)
  • Provide structured root cause analysis and resolution

Key Responsibilities

  • Build and maintain scalable data pipelines (end-to-end ownership)
  • Design and optimize transformation logic and SQL processes
  • Work on database architecture and distributed systems
  • Ensure data quality, validation, and reliability
  • Monitor pipelines and troubleshoot production issues
  • Integrate data from APIs and multiple systems
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams
  • Take technical decisions, not just execute tasks

Required Skills

Core

  • Strong SQL and Python
  • End-to-end pipeline experience
  • Data modeling and architecture understanding
  • LEVEL ENGLISH B2

Cloud (Very Important)

  • Experience with AWS 5+ years
  • Preferably strong and recent AWS experience
  • Hands-on experience (not just exposure)

Technical Depth

  • ETL / ELT processes
  • APIs and integrations
  • Distributed systems

Problem Solving (Critical)

  • Troubleshooting in production
  • Debugging pipelines and dashboards
  • Structured and analytical thinking

Ideal Candidate

  • Has hands-on experience building pipelines
  • Thinks beyond execution (design + architecture)
  • Understands data end-to-end
  • Has worked on real production issues
  • Can explain technical decisions clearly

What the client is really looking for

  • Design pipelines, not just build them
  • Think like a data architect
  • Solve real production problems
  • Operate as a senior-level engineer with ownership

Additional Benefits

  • Contract type CONTRACTOR
  • Rate: We are open to negotiating and listening to tariff proposals.
  • Contract without an expiration date (Not per project)
  • 100% remote modality in LATAM.
  • Career plan and continuous training.
  • Flexible work environment and excellent working environment.
  • Respect for your country's official holidays.


If you are passionate about creating meaningful experiences and transforming organizational cultures, I have for you not only a job offer BUT A LIFE EXPERIENCE!


Would you like to participate?

title: Product Owner Sênior
description:
Estamos em busca de um Product Owner Sênior para liderar a evolução de produtos digitais no segmento de saúde, com forte proximidade das rotinas médicas, jornadas de consulta, fluxos clínicos e necessidades reais dos médicos e times assistenciais.

Esse profissional será responsável por atuar como elo entre negócio, tecnologia, usuários e stakeholders, garantindo que as decisões de produto gerem valor para a operação, melhorem a experiência dos profissionais de saúde e pacientes, e sustentem os objetivos estratégicos da organização.


O perfil ideal combina sólida experiência em produto com capacidade de entender a dinâmica do ambiente de saúde, especialmente a lógica por trás de consultas médicas, documentação clínica, jornadas assistenciais, gargalos operacionais e usabilidade para o médico no dia a dia.

Principais responsabilidades


  • Gerenciar e priorizar o backlog do produto, garantindo alinhamento com os objetivos do negócio e as necessidades dos usuários.
  • Traduzir objetivos estratégicos em requisitos claros, épicos, histórias de usuário e critérios de aceitação.
  • Atuar em parceria com stakeholders das áreas de saúde, operação, negócio, tecnologia, UX e dados.
  • Entender e mapear fluxos ponta a ponta do ambiente de saúde, incluindo consultas, agendamentos, prontuários, documentação clínica e rotinas de apoio ao médico.
  • Levantar necessidades diretamente com usuários, especialmente médicos, equipes clínicas e times operacionais.
  • Identificar dores nas rotinas médicas e administrativas, transformando essas necessidades em oportunidades de produto.
  • Priorizar funcionalidades com base em valor de negócio, impacto para o usuário, viabilidade técnica e urgência.
  • Participar ativamente das cerimônias ágeis, apoiando o time com direcionamento funcional e esclarecimento contínuo de requisitos.
  • Garantir que o produto entregue eficiência operacional, boa usabilidade, adoção e resultados mensuráveis.
  • Conduzir ou apoiar atividades de discovery, como entrevistas, análise de fluxos, validações e testes de hipótese.
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com times de engenharia e design para construir soluções práticas e centradas no usuário.
  • Acompanhar indicadores de desempenho do produto, métricas de uso, feedbacks e resultados operacionais.
  • Promover a melhoria contínua dos produtos, equilibrando necessidades regulatórias, operacionais e de experiência do usuário.
  • Atuar como principal referência da squad em decisões de escopo, priorização e direcionamento funcional.


Requisitos obrigatórios

  • Experiência comprovada como Product Owner, Product Owner Sênior ou função equivalente em produto.
  • Vivência sólida em ambientes ágeis, com atuação junto a squads multidisciplinares.
  • Experiência no segmento de saúde, healthtech, operações clínicas, sistemas médicos ou contextos correlatos.
  • Forte compreensão de fluxos de saúde, especialmente relacionados a consultas médicas, rotina do médico, agendamentos, jornada do paciente e necessidades assistenciais.
  • Capacidade de compreender o que o médico precisa em termos de sistema, processo e usabilidade, mesmo quando a demanda não vem totalmente estruturada.
  • Experiência na escrita de histórias de usuário, definição de critérios de aceitação e gestão estruturada de backlog.
  • Habilidade de relacionamento e gestão de stakeholders.
  • Capacidade de conectar estratégia de negócio com execução de produto e entrega de tecnologia.
  • Perfil analítico, com capacidade de usar dados, evidências e feedbacks para apoiar priorização e tomada de decisão.
  • Capacidade de atuar em ambientes complexos, com múltiplos stakeholders e mudanças de prioridade.


Requisitos desejáveis

  • Experiência prévia com produtos relacionados a: prontuário eletrônico,
  • agendamento de consultas, telemedicina, otimização de fluxo clínico, portais médicos, jornada do paciente, coordenação do cuidado, plataformas assistenciais.
  • Familiaridade com requisitos regulatórios, privacidade e compliance no setor de saúde.
  • Experiência com integrações entre sistemas de saúde e interoperabilidade.
  • Vivência com médicos, clínicas, hospitais, centros diagnósticos ou operações assistenciais.
  • Experiência com discovery e desenho de serviços em contexto de saúde.
  • Conhecimento de métricas relacionadas à eficiência clínica, fluxo de atendimento, adoção e performance operacional.


Competências esperadas

  • Forte senso de dono sobre o produto
  • Excelente capacidade de priorização
  • Visão de negócio com foco no usuário
  • Capacidade de lidar com ambiguidade e transformar demandas em backlog acionável
  • Escuta ativa e boa facilitação
  • Empatia com médicos, pacientes e equipes operacionais
  • Comunicação clara com públicos técnicos e não técnicos
  • Pensamento estruturado para solução de problemas
  • Tomada de decisão orientada a valor e impacto
  • Alto nível de autonomia e accountability


O que esperamos de sucesso nessa posição


  • O roadmap do produto reflita prioridades reais do negócio e da operação em saúde.
  • Médicos e usuários clínicos percebam que o produto apoia, e não dificulta, a rotina do dia a dia.
  • Os requisitos estejam claros o suficiente para permitir execução eficiente pelo time de tecnologia.
  • As entregas gerem ganhos concretos de eficiência, qualidade operacional, adoção e experiência do usuário.
  • A squad tenha clareza sobre prioridades, contexto e objetivos de negócio.


Diferencial importante

Buscamos alguém que não apenas conheça produto, mas que tenha sensibilidade para entender a lógica do ambiente médico, conseguindo traduzir necessidades assistenciais e operacionais em soluções digitais de alto valor.

title: Desenvolvedor de software em teste
description:
Quem Somos

A DEXIAN é uma consultoria global de origem Americana focada em talentos para complementar a equipe de tecnologia da informação de nossos clientes. Estamos presente em 10 países, com 45 escritórios ao redor do mundo. Por mais de 25 anos, a DEXIAN® atende indústrias e clientes globais, em diversas áreas, com a missão de atrair e reter os maiores talentos do mundo.

Hoje somos orgulhosamente reconhecidos como uma das maiores empresas de “staffing augmentation” dos Estados Unidos pela Staffing Industry Analysts (SIA). Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.

No Brasil, chegamos em 2007 e de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia.


O que esperar de nós

É importante que você saiba que por trás de cada movimento DEXIAN existem cinco valores fundamentais: colaboração, respeito, justiça, comprometimento e engenhosidade. Colaboração, justiça e respeito não são apenas palavras; comprometimento não é só um pensamento; e engenhosidade vai além de aspiração. Essas qualidades nos definem em todos os níveis, todas as parcerias e na forma como trabalhamos todos os dias. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?

A DEXIAN do Brasil incentiva a DIVERSIDADE. Nossas oportunidades também estão disponíveis para candidatura de pessoas com deficiência e reabilitados.


Nosso Cliente

Esta posição atuará em apoio ao nosso cliente, uma multinacional líder no segmento de cruzeiros marítimos.


Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and maintain automated test scripts using Selenium and Playwright for mobile and API layers
  • Build and execute test cases mapped to JIRA user stories and acceptance criteria
  • Conduct functional, regression, smoke, and exploratory testing across Android and iOS
  • File and manage defects in JIRA, providing detailed reproduction steps and severity assessment
  • Support parallel test execution and help triage automation results from CI/CD runs
  • Work alongside Mobile developers in a collaborative, shift-left testing approach
  • Maintain and improve test data management strategies for consistent test execution
  • Provide QA sign-off on user stories prior to sprint completion
  • Participate in all Agile ceremonies and contribute to continuous improvement discussions

Required Qualifications

  • Advenced english is primordial, you'll work with an international team.
  • 5+ years of QA automation or SDET experience
  • Proficiency with Selenium WebDriver and Playwright
  • Strong scripting skills in Python, Java, JavaScript, or TypeScript
  • Experience with mobile automation using Appium and/or native testing frameworks
  • Proven use of JIRA for test management, defect tracking, and sprint participation
  • Familiarity with CI/CD integration for automated test suites
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to work on multiple test workstreams simultaneously
  • Solid understanding of software QA methodologies and Agile practices
  • Working knowledge of Test Driven Development (TDD) principles and experience contributing to TDD-based workflows
  • Experience with parallel test execution strategies and grid-based testing (Selenium Grid)
  • Background in performance or load testing for mobile backends
  • Familiarity with version control (Git) and pull-request-based QA review workflows


Onde você vai trabalhar?

Regime 100% Home Office.


Tempo de Projeto:

Tempo indeterminado.

title: Business Development Representative
description:
Job Title: Business Development Representative

Company: DolFinContent LLC

Location: Remote

Employment Type: Full Time (Contractor)


About DolFinContent

DolFinContent LLC is a talent agency specializing in influencers, representing digital creators worldwide and connecting them with brands through strategic partnerships, sponsorships, and campaign opportunities. The agency focuses on long-term creator growth, brand alignment, and professional representation within the creator economy.


Position Overview

DolFinContent is seeking a Business Development Representative to support the continued expansion of the agency’s influencer roster. This role focuses on identifying high-potential creators, conducting professional outreach, managing onboarding, and supporting talent relationship development. The ideal candidate is highly organized, proactive, detail-oriented, and passionate about social media, creator partnerships, and talent development.


Key Responsibilities

• Identify, source, and recruit influencers and digital creators across major social media platforms, including TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, Twitch, Kick, and emerging platforms

• Conduct professional outreach through social media platforms, email communication, and networking tools

• Manage the onboarding process for new creators, including agreements, internal documentation, and profile setup

• Build and maintain strong professional relationships with creators through consistent communication

• Maintain accurate internal databases, including talent rosters, creator profiles, and recruitment pipelines

• Research social media trends and identify emerging creators with strong growth potential

• Collaborate with Talent and Sales teams to support campaign opportunities and roster growth

• Track recruitment activity, outreach performance, and talent acquisition metrics

• Provide weekly recruitment reports and progress updates

• Support general talent operations and recruitment initiatives as needed


Skills and Qualifications

• Native or fluent English proficiency (written and verbal) is required

• Excellent organizational and time management abilities

• Strong attention to detail and ability to manage multiple priorities

• Interest in influencer marketing, talent management, recruiting, or digital media

• Ability to work independently in a remote environment

• Experience with Google Sheets, Excel, CRM systems, or outreach tools is preferred

• Previous experience in recruiting, talent sourcing, or influencer marketing is a plus


Compensation

• Base compensation of 1,000 USD per month

• Commission opportunities based on creators successfully recruited and onboarded

• Performance-based earning potential with growth opportunities


What We Offer

• Direct experience within the influencer marketing and talent management industry

• Opportunity to work with a growing global talent agency

• Professional development within talent acquisition and creator partnerships

• Remote work environment

• Performance-based growth opportunities


How to Apply

If you are passionate about social media, talent discovery, and relationship building, we encourage you to apply and join DolFinContent’s growing global team.

title: \"Aplication Change Management System Engineer #1001025\"
description:
Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.


Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. title: Coordenador de Engenharia de Processo
description:
VAGA ABERTA | Engenharia de Processos / Manufatura


Objetivo da Posição

Atuar no desenvolvimento, análise e otimização dos processos produtivos da fábrica, com foco em eficiência operacional, qualidade, redução de custos, segurança e atendimento às demandas de produção, incluindo processos de Corte, Lead Prep, Projetos, Protótipos, Layout e Equipamentos .


Principais Responsabilidades


  • Revisar e/ou elaborar documentação de processos por meio de observação direta.
  • Estudar layouts fabris (medições, desenhos, projeções em escala e reuniões técnicas).
  • Determinar mão de obra direta utilizando estudos de tempos e métodos.
  • Desenvolver processos e dispositivos à prova de erro (Poka-Yoke).
  • Propor melhorias para aumento da qualidade, eficiência e redução de desperdícios.
  • Identificar necessidades de serviços externos e realizar cotações.
  • Adequar os meios produtivos conforme variações de volume do cliente.
  • Acompanhar o planejamento semanal de produção, garantindo eficiência planejada.
  • Analisar capacidade produtiva das máquinas de corte e lead prep.
  • Avaliar mercado de máquinas e tecnologias para melhoria dos processos.
  • Desenvolver estudos de layout para compra de peças e equipamentos.
  • Acompanhar validações de crimpagem em laboratório.
  • Garantir conformidade com normas, procedimentos e padrões de qualidade.
  • Acompanhar o desenvolvimento de novos produtos, do protótipo aos ensaios.
  • Identificar causas de scrap, desperdícios, paradas e desvios de qualidade.
  • Otimizar tempos de setup e preparação para redução de ociosidade.
  • Garantir resultados financeiros (redução de HE, eficiência, custos).
  • Validar cotações de modificações e gerenciar mudanças solicitadas pelos clientes.
  • Estudar e coordenar alterações de layout fabril.
  • Acompanhar custos de projetos (CAPEX e Expenses).
  • Analisar indicadores e garantir os melhores resultados para o negócio.
  • Supervisionar condições de segurança, higiene e 5S na fábrica.
  • Promover a melhoria contínua em EHS.
  • Liderar a cultura de segurança na Planta.
  • Incentivar participação em CIPA, Brigada de Emergência e Subcomitês.
  • Garantir o cumprimento das instruções de segurança e uso de EPIs.


Requisitos Desejáveis

  • Formação superior em Engenharia (Produção, Mecânica, Elétrica ou áreas correlatas);
  • Experiência em processos industriais;
  • Vivência com layout fabril, tempos e métodos, melhoria contínua;
  • Conhecimento em Lean Manufacturing, Poka-Yoke, 5S.


Diferenciais

  • Experiência com projetos, protótipos e pré-produção;
  • Atuação com CAPEX, equipamentos industriais e validações técnicas.

title: Business Specialist
description:
Sobre la Empresa



Esta fase se centra en garantizar que toda la documentación sea correcta antes del envío. Incluye recibir y verificar la Orden de Compra (PO), la clasificación fiscal (NCM) de los bienes, analizar documentos preliminares (borradores de CI, PL, BL) y el registro inicial en el sistema.



Sobre el Rol



Esta etapa cubre la gestión activa del proceso mientras la carga está en tránsito. Involucra obtener la Licencia de Importación (LI), recopilar documentos originales, validar el Conocimiento de Embarque (BL) y coordinar continuamente con el agente de aduanas y la terminal aduanera.



Responsabilidades



  • Monitoreo de la llegada de la carga.
  • Confirmación de la presencia de la carga.
  • Monitoreo de la liberación de aduanas (DI/DUIMP).
  • Coordinación del transporte nacional.
  • Archivado de todos los documentos para cerrar el proceso.


Calificaciones



Esta fase se centra en verificar la precisión de todos los costos operativos antes del pago. Incluye recibir y cruzar facturas (de transitarios, transportistas, terminales, agentes de aduanas) contra tarifas negociadas, registros operativos y datos del sistema (por ejemplo, días de demoras/detenciones, tarifas de almacenamiento) para identificar y disputar discrepancias.



Habilidades Requeridas



  • Procesamiento de pagos y asignación de presupuesto.
  • Ejecutar y controlar financieramente.
  • Lanzar facturas aprobadas en el sistema financiero (ERP).
  • Asignar correctamente todos los costos al proceso de importación específico o centro de costos.
  • Programar pagos de acuerdo con la política financiera.
  • Servir como el principal punto de contacto para consultas de pago de proveedores.


Habilidades Preferidas



  • Análisis de costos y elaboración de informes de rendimiento.
  • Compilación de datos financieros.
  • Generación de informes periódicos (por ejemplo, costo total de logística, costo por contenedor, análisis de variaciones contra el presupuesto).
  • Proporcionar información basada en datos para apoyar nuevas negociaciones con proveedores e identificar oportunidades de ahorro de costos.


Rango de Pago y Paquete de Compensación



Rango de pago o salario o compensación.



Declaración de Igualdad de Oportunidades



Incluir una declaración sobre el compromiso con la diversidad y la inclusión.

title: Senior Digital Analytics Engineer
description:
Company Description

In 1995, Acronym created a digital marketing revolution by innovating a futuristic model of the marketing agency. Since then, we’ve forged a lasting path of success helping our Clients achieve their business goals.

Acronym. Our name signifies our deep understanding of both our Clients’ and industries lexicon. For our Clients, it means an independent performance marketing agency with the flexibility to find solutions for any need, turning insights into action and action into results. We are headquartered in the iconic Empire State Building, with a presence across EMEA and APAC.


Role Description

The Remote Senior Digital Analytics Engineer will join our Analytics & Optimization team. This team member will be instrumental in implementing and maintaining sophisticated digital analytics solutions for our clients, ensuring a robust data foundation that drives strategic business decisions. You will leverage your deep technical expertise and understanding of business objectives to guide clients on best practices and implement cutting-edge tracking strategies. This role will also have the opportunity to explore and implement emerging technologies, including AI-powered tools, to enhance data collection and efficiency over time. Some of the solutions this team member will be working with on a regular basis include Adobe Launch, Adobe Analytics, Google Analytics, Google Tag Manager, and Tealium iQ. 


This is the job…


·      Providing strategic guidance on data collection architecture and implementation strategies for web, app, and marketing technology solutions, acting as a technical leader on client engagements. 

·      Ensuring that all data collection and implementation efforts are aligned with client business objectives and contribute to the delivery of accurate and actionable insights that drive measurable results.

·      Working directly with technical stakeholders to answer questions, and help troubleshoot issues.

·      Creating technical documentation for our clients on how to best implement various web analytics tools such as Google Analytics and Adobe Analytics, as well as other marketing technologies.

·      Expertly configuring tag management systems (e.g., Adobe Launch, Google Tag Manager, Tealium iQ), analytics platforms (e.g., Adobe Analytics, Google Analytics, Adobe Customer Journey Analytics) and various third-party tracking pixels (Meta, LinkedIn, etc) based on sound data collection principles and industry best practices, as part of a comprehensive data collection strategy.

·      Providing Quality Assurance (QA) of technical stakeholder deployments while thinking ahead on how to build solutions that solve common problems increasing efficiencies and improving data quality.

·      Implementing and maintaining server-side tracking solutions to enhance data accuracy, improve user privacy, and overcome browser limitations.

·      Integrating analytics platforms with other marketing and business systems (e.g., CRM, advertising platforms) using APIs to create a unified view of customer data.

·      Optimizing analytics implementations for website and application performance to ensure tracking does not negatively impact user experience.

title: Conversion Rate Optimization Manager
description:
*Native/Bilingual English is required for this role (read/written/spoken)


Please upload your CV Resume in English.


Monthly salary: $2,000 - $2,200 USD


Along with our partner, we are seeking a Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO) Manager who will drive revenue growth by optimizing conversion rates, improving user experience, and reducing friction across the customer journey on their Shopify storefront. You will oversee and execute A/B testing, user behavior analyses, funnel audits, and UX gap analyses. You will have the knowledge and experience to use CRO reports, experiment results, and dashboards to identify areas for optimization and will lead projects to implement those findings. You will conduct competitive research and deploy the latest developments in conversion rate optimization in partnership with their development and ecommerce teams.


Essential Functions

  • A/B Testing and Experimentation: Design, execute, and analyze A/B and multivariate tests across key pages and touchpoints. Prioritize experiments based on potential impact, traffic, and business goals to build a rigorous, data-driven testing roadmap.
  • On-Site Optimization: Optimize landing pages, product detail pages (PDPs), collection pages, cart, and checkout flows to maximize conversion. Collaborate with their ecommerce and design teams to ensure all pages are aligned with CRO best practices.
  • User Behavior Analysis: Leverage heatmaps, session recordings, funnel analytics, and user surveys to uncover friction points and opportunities. Translate qualitative and quantitative insights into actionable hypotheses.
  • Shopify & Development Collaboration: Partner closely with their development team to implement CRO changes on the Shopify platform. Ensure experiments and site updates are implemented accurately, QA tested, and deployed efficiently.
  • Funnel & Revenue Optimization: Identify and prioritize drop-off points across the customer journey from acquisition through post-purchase and develop initiatives to reduce abandonment, increase AOV, and improve repeat purchase rates.
  • Reporting and Analysis: Provide regular reports on CRO performance, experiment results, and KPIs using analytics and CRO tools. Communicate findings and recommendations clearly to stakeholders and leadership.
  • Other duties may be assigned


What you will bring / Qualifications

To perform this job successfully, you must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily.

The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required.

  • In-depth knowledge of CRO principles, UX best practices, and e-commerce conversion frameworks.
  • Strong understanding of A/B testing methodology, statistical significance, and experiment design.
  • Hands-on experience with Shopify or a comparable e-commerce platform; ability to collaborate effectively with development teams on implementation.
  • Proficiency in using CRO and analytics tools such as Google Analytics, heatmap tools, and experimentation platforms.
  • Ability to read, analyze, and interpret complex data sets, experiment results, and performance reports.
  • Ability to present findings and recommendations to cross-functional teams and leadership.
  • Ability to solve practical problems and apply structured experimentation methodology in ambiguous situations.
  • Ability to interpret quantitative and qualitative data to form clear, testable hypotheses.
  • Ability to calculate and interpret key metrics such as conversion rates, statistical significance, and revenue metrics.


Education and/or experience

  • Bachelor’s degree from a four-year college or university, or equivalent experience as a CRO specialist or analyst in e-commerce.
  • 3–5 years of experience managing a CRO program or cross-functional optimization team.


Core competencies

  • Action Oriented: Taking on new opportunities and challenges with urgency and energy.
  • Resourcefulness: Securing and deploying resources effectively.
  • Collaboration: Building partnerships and working collaboratively with others.
  • Self-Development: Actively seeking growth opportunities.
  • Strategic Thinking: Identifying opportunities and adapting to trends.
  • Technical Proficiency & Problem Solving: Using tools and data to drive solutions.
  • Communication: Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Results-driven: Focused on measurable, data-driven outcomes.


Benefits

  • A fully remote position with a structured schedule that supports work-life balance.
  • The opportunity to drive measurable revenue growth by optimizing user experience and conversion performance.
  • Two weeks of paid vacation per year.
  • 10 paid days for local holidays.


*Please note our partner is only looking for full-time dedicated team members who are eager to fully integrate within their team.

title: Salesforce Administrator
description:
Position Overview:

As a Salesforce Administrator, you will play a foundational role in building and scaling our CRM ecosystem. This position goes far beyond traditional administration—you will help architect a next‑generation CRM platform that supports rapid scaling, automation‑first operations, and AI‑driven decision‑making across the organization.


You will partner closely with Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, Product, Engineering, and our Contact Center leadership team to design intelligent workflows, optimize business processes, and create a flexible, automated CRM foundation.


Responsibilities:

  • Administers day‑to‑day Salesforce operations, including user access, permissions, security controls, page layouts, objects, record types, and data governance.
  • Builds scalable automation (primarily using Flows) to replace manual processes and improve operational efficiency across teams.
  • Partners with cross‑functional stakeholders to map business processes, identify gaps, and design technical solutions aligned with business requirements.
  • Translates business requirements into detailed user stories, functional specifications, and structured workflows.
  • Analyzes CRM usage patterns, funnel metrics, and customer service trends to recommend operational and process improvements.
  • Builds dashboards and reports that surface insights for leaders, including case trends, SLA performance, agent productivity, lifecycle metrics, and GTM funnel health.
  • Maintains documentation of data models, configurations, integrations, automations, and process maps.
  • Collaborates with stakeholders to build lead management flows, sales processes, customer lifecycle models, and AI‑powered workflow automations.
  • Designs, optimizes, and maintains Salesforce Service Cloud functionality supporting the Contact Center, including case management, omni‑channel routing, macros, and agent console configurations.
  • Partners with Contact Center leadership to analyze operational bottlenecks and design scalable workflows that reduce agent handle time and improve customer experience.
  • Supports and enhances CTI/telephony integrations and related automations, including screen pops, routing logic, call dispositions, and agent productivity tooling.
  • Ensures secure, least‑privilege access by owning the configuration and governance of profiles, permission sets, and role hierarchies aligned with Contact Center needs.
  • Identifies proactively opportunities to improve processes, workflows, routing, and system performance, particularly within the Contact Center environment.
  • Manages data imports and updates, including deduplication, cleansing initiatives, and data governance enforcement.
  • Supports integration efforts with core internal systems, marketing automation platforms, billing solutions, and internal tools.
  • Delivers training, onboarding, and ongoing support to drive strong user adoption across fast‑scaling teams.
  • Troubleshoots issues proactively and serves as the go‑to expert for Salesforce reliability, scalability, and performance.


Position Requirements:

  • 4 years of Salesforce Administration experience, ideally in an enterprise‑level or high‑velocity environment.
  • Salesforce certifications, such as Administrator or Advanced Administrator, are preferred.
  • Ability to work from our Austin-based headquarters, at least four days per week – excluding approved time off and business travel.


Additional Requirements:

  • Strong expertise in Salesforce configuration, automation (Flows), data modeling, and security architecture.
  • Experience supporting Contact Center or Service Cloud environments, including agent workflows, case management, routing, or telephony integrations (preferred).
  • Proven ability in requirements gathering, process design, workflow mapping, and reporting/analytics.
  • Background supporting Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, or cross‑functional GTM operations.
  • Strong analytical skills, with the ability to turn CRM data into insights and actionable recommendations.
  • Familiarity with integrations, connected apps, APIs, middleware, and data sync patterns (no coding required, but technical comfort is essential).
  • Hands‑on experience with lead routing, funnel analytics, lifecycle automation, or revenue operations tooling is highly valued.
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to influence stakeholders in a fast‑moving, high‑growth environment.

We are looking for a skilled Firewall Engineer to provide L3-level support from a nearshore location in Latin America, with a strong focus on F5 technologies . This role involves operational support, configuration, troubleshooting, and optimization of F5 devices and related security infrastructure.


Key Responsibilities

• Perform L3 troubleshooting for application delivery, load balancing, and firewall-related issues

DolFinContent LLC is a talent agency specializing in influencers, representing digital creators worldwide and connecting them with brands through strategic partnerships, sponsorships, and campaign opportunities. If you are passionate about social media, talent discovery, and relationship building, we encourage you to apply and join DolFinContent’s growing global team.

title: Gerente de Testes
description:
Esta posição é responsável pela supervisão de testes de ponta a ponta, incluindo execução da estratégia, gerenciamento de recursos, coordenação com as partes interessadas, gerenciamento de riscos e relatórios de progresso.

O Gerente de Testes planeja, controla e aprimora continuamente as atividades de teste para garantir que o software e os sistemas integrados atendam aos padrões de qualidade definidos antes do lançamento. Isso inclui definir objetivos de qualidade, apoiar a automação de testes quando apropriado e garantir que as equipes compreendam claramente os processos de teste, controles e expectativas de governança.

Responsável por impulsionar práticas de teste consistentes e de alta qualidade em múltiplos projetos. A função garante um modelo de governança unificado, metodologias alinhadas e resultados de entrega previsíveis.



Principais Responsabilidades


• Definir, comunicar e garantir o cumprimento da estratégia geral de testes junto a todas as partes interessadas e equipes de entrega.

• Identificar, garantir e coordenar os recursos de teste alinhados ao escopo e aos marcos de entrega.

• Garantir que os ambientes de teste, os dados e as integrações de sistema estejam disponíveis e adequados à finalidade.

• Analisar e gerenciar defeitos, riscos e problemas decorrentes de todas as fases de teste.

Estabelecer e manter um repositório centralizado de cenários e ativos de teste.

• Identificar e reutilizar materiais de teste existentes para melhorar a eficiência e a consistência.

• Definir e finalizar o escopo de testes em conjunto com todas as áreas impactadas.

• Definir, preparar e validar os requisitos de dados de teste de acordo com o escopo acordado.

• Desenvolver planos detalhados de execução de testes diários, incluindo cenários de contingência e de menor prioridade.

• Definir e obter consenso sobre critérios claros de conclusão dos ciclos de teste.

• Identificar e gerenciar o escopo de testes de regressão para proteger a funcionalidade existente.


Requisitos

Profissional Senior, com experiência comprovada liderando iniciativas complexas de testes em sistemas de grande escala.

• Ampla experiência prática em testes de software e garantia de qualidade em ambientes corporativos.

• Capacidade comprovada de liderar, coordenar e motivar equipes de teste em múltiplos fluxos de trabalho.

• Sólida experiência em planejamento, escopo, estimativa e análise de testes.

• Excelentes habilidades de comunicação e colaboração com stakeholders em equipes de negócios e técnicas.

• Mentalidade analítica com forte capacidade de resolução de problemas e atenção aos detalhes.

• Experiência comprovada na definição, implementação e gestão de estratégias e planos de teste.

• Sólido conhecimento de modelos SDLC e uma ampla gama de metodologias de teste.

• Conhecimento prático de ferramentas, frameworks e melhores práticas de automação de testes.

A Getronics é líder global em soluções de tecnologia, com uma equipe de mais de 4.000 colegas em 22 países, fornecendo serviços abrangentes de ponta a ponta em todo o mundo. Temos o compromisso de oferecer um atendimento excepcional ao cliente, para permitir que eles se concentrem em seus principais pontos fortes, enquanto confiam suas necessidades de TI à Getronics. Temos uma oportunidade incrível para você se juntar à nossa equipe, na seguinte vaga: DevOps - Remoto


O que oferecemos a você

- Assistência médica sem desconto para titulares;

- Assistência odontológica sem desconto para titulares;

- Cartão flex tanto para alimentação quanto refeição;

- Auxílio home office para vaga remota;

- Vale transporte para posições presenciais ou híbridas;

- Auxílio creche;

- Seguro de vida;

- Desconto em terapia: plataforma de apoio psicossocial;

- Parceria com instituições de ensino;

- Parceria com escolas de idiomas;

- Programa de subsídio para aulas de inglês;

- Programa de indicações: prêmio para indicações bem-sucedidas;

- Licença maternidade estendida de 180 dias e a licença paternidade de 20 dias;

- Treinamento completo fornecido como parte de um processo de indução robusto, incluindo oportunidades de desenvolvimento contínuo com nossa plataforma de aprendizado online NorthStar, LinkedIn Learning e Udemy, que possui mais de 80.000 cursos disponíveis;

- GetVibes - nosso programa de escuta ativa que nos permite conectar e ouvir feedback de todos os colegas, e como empresa, trabalhamos juntos para elaborar planos de ação para melhorar e desenvolver continuamente a Getronics!


O que esperar desta posição:

Atuação em projeto de desenvolvimento e melhorias em sistemas bancários.


O que esperamos de você:

Obrigatório

  • Conhecimentos básicos em Linux (terminal, análise de logs e processos)
  • Lógica de programação e/ou scripting (Python, Bash ou similar)
  • Noções de Git (clone, commit, pull request)
  • Conceitos iniciais de automação e infraestrutura como código
  • Conhecimento conceitual sobre containers e Kubernetes/OpenShift
  • Capacidade de leitura e entendimento de arquivos YAML





O que fazer em seguida:

Caso você seja a pessoa que estamos procurando, aguarde nosso contato para te conhecermos melhor e siga as instruções durante o processo seletivo. Se você gostaria de fazer alguma pergunta sobre nossas vagas, sobre a Getronics como empresa ou qualquer outra coisa, por favor, não hesite em entrar em contato. A equipe de RH estará disponível no e-mail .

title: Analista de Folha de Pagamento Sênior (APDATA)
description:
#Vemparaotimeloungerie


Já pensou em trabalhar em uma empresa que quer romper tabus, preconceitos, barreiras e padrões


Essa é a Loungerie!


Estamos em busca de uma Analista de Folha de Pagamento Sênior com sólido conhecimento no sistema APDATA , para tuar de forma estratégica na gestão da folha de pagamento, garantindo compliance, precisão nos processos e suporte às áreas do negócio.


Responsabilidades


• Liderar o ciclo completo de fechamento da folha de pagamento, incluindo parametrizações e regras no sistema Apdata;

• Garantir a correta aplicação das Convenções Coletivas (CCTs) para lojas e matriz;

• Realizar a transmissão e auditoria de eventos no eSocial (tabelas, periódicos e não periódicos);

• Gerar e acompanhar a DCTFWeb, assegurando conformidade com obrigações legais;

• Apurar e conferir encargos: INSS, FGTS (Digital), IRRF e contribuições sindicais;

• Realizar conciliações entre folha, contábil e financeiro, incluindo provisões (férias e 13º);

• Atuar na análise de notas fiscais de prestadores de serviço (PJs);

• Apoiar auditorias e processos trabalhistas, organizando evidências e propondo melhorias;

• Atender gestores e colaboradores em dúvidas relacionadas à folha, legislação e processos.


Requisitos


• Experiência sólida com folha de pagamento e encargos;

• Domínio do sistema Apdata (com foco em parametrização e integrações);

• Conhecimento aprofundado da legislação trabalhista (CLT) e regras de retenção;

• Excel avançado (PROCV, Tabela Dinâmica e desejável Macros);

• Ensino superior completo em Administração, RH, Contabilidade ou Direito;

• Pós-graduação será um diferencial.


Competências comportamentais


• Visão analítica e sistêmica;

• Comunicação clara e didática;

• Resiliência e equilíbrio emocional;

• Senso de dono e responsabilidade pelos resultados.


Benefícios


• Local: Berrini – Zona Sul/SP

• Modelo de trabalho: Híbrido

• Vale Refeição e Vale Alimentação

• Assistência Médica e Odontológica

• Seguro de Vida

• Desconto em produtos da marca

• Day Off no aniversário

• Gympass e Zenklub

• Médico na Tela (telemedicina)

title: Talent Recruiter LATAM
description:
Job Title: Talent Recruiter (Influencers)

Company: DolFinContent LLC

Location: Remote

Employment Type: Full Time (Contractor)


About DolFinContent

DolFinContent LLC is a talent agency specializing in influencers, representing digital creators worldwide and connecting them with brands through strategic partnerships, sponsorships, and campaign opportunities. The agency focuses on long-term creator growth, brand alignment, and professional representation within the creator economy.


Position Overview

DolFinContent is seeking a Talent Recruiter to support the continued expansion of the agency’s influencer roster. This role focuses on identifying high-potential creators, conducting professional outreach, managing onboarding, and supporting talent relationship development. The ideal candidate is highly organized, proactive, detail-oriented, and passionate about social media, creator partnerships, and talent development.


Key Responsibilities

• Identify, source, and recruit influencers and digital creators across major social media platforms, including TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, Twitch, Kick, and emerging platforms

• Conduct professional outreach through social media platforms, email communication, and networking tools

• Manage the onboarding process for new creators, including agreements, internal documentation, and profile setup

• Build and maintain strong professional relationships with creators through consistent communication

• Maintain accurate internal databases, including talent rosters, creator profiles, and recruitment pipelines

• Research social media trends and identify emerging creators with strong growth potential

• Collaborate with Talent and Sales teams to support campaign opportunities and roster growth

• Track recruitment activity, outreach performance, and talent acquisition metrics

• Provide weekly recruitment reports and progress updates

• Support general talent operations and recruitment initiatives as needed


Skills and Qualifications

• Native or fluent English proficiency (written and verbal) is required

• Excellent organizational and time management abilities

• Strong attention to detail and ability to manage multiple priorities

• Interest in influencer marketing, talent management, recruiting, or digital media

• Ability to work independently in a remote environment

• Experience with Google Sheets, Excel, CRM systems, or outreach tools is preferred

• Previous experience in recruiting, talent sourcing, or influencer marketing is a plus


Compensation

• Base compensation of 1,000 USD per month

• Commission opportunities based on creators successfully recruited and onboarded

• Performance-based earning potential with growth opportunities


What We Offer

• Direct experience within the influencer marketing and talent management industry

• Opportunity to work with a growing global talent agency

• Professional development within talent acquisition and creator partnerships

• Remote work environment

• Performance-based growth opportunities


How to Apply

If you are passionate about social media, talent discovery, and relationship building, we encourage you to apply and join DolFinContent’s growing global team.

title: Remote Video Data Annotators - 74491
description:
About Turing:

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L.


Role Overview:

We are looking for highly detail-oriented Video Data Annotators to support cutting-edge AI/ML initiatives focused on first-person (egocentric) video understanding .

In this role, you will analyze video clips and answer questions based strictly on what is visually observable at a specific moment in time. Your work will directly contribute to training and improving advanced vision-language models.

This is a precision-driven role that requires strong observational skills, disciplined thinking, and the ability to follow strict guidelines.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Review first-person video clips and analyze visual content at specific timestamps
  • Provide accurate, concise, and evidence-based answers grounded in visible information
  • Identify and select the exact visual evidence supporting each answer
  • Determine whether a question is valid or unanswerable based on the available video content
  • Ensure no use of future frames or external assumptions when answering questions
  • Maintain high consistency and accuracy across large volumes of tasks
  • Adhere strictly to project guidelines, formatting, and quality standards
  • Perform self-review to ensure alignment between question, evidence, and answer


Required Skills and Qualifications:

Core Skills

  • Strong attention to detail and ability to spot subtle visual differences
  • Excellent observational and visual interpretation skills
  • Clear and concise written communication
  • Strong reading comprehension and understanding of nuanced questions
  • Critical thinking and logical reasoning (sequence, counting, spatial awareness)
  • Ability to remain objective and avoid assumptions beyond visible data

Behavioral Traits

  • High level of focus and consistency in repetitive, detail-heavy tasks
  • Strong ownership and accountability for quality of work
  • Ability to follow strict guidelines with high precision
  • Self-driven with a proactive quality-check mindset


Preferred Backgrounds:

  • Experience in data annotation, data labeling, or content moderation
  • Exposure to image/video annotation or computer vision projects
  • Background in QA, quality assurance, or analytical roles
  • Familiarity with AI/ML data workflows is a plus


Offer Details:

  • Commitments Required : 40 hours per week with at least 4 hours PST overlap
  • Employment type : Contractor assignment (no medical/paid leave)
  • Duration of contract : 4 weeks; (expected start date is next week)


Evaluation Process:

Candidates will need to complete an assessment, after which the team will reach out with the next steps.


After applying, you will receive an email with a login link. Please use that link to access the portal and complete your profile.


Know amazing talent? Refer them at turing.com/referrals, and earn money from your network.

title: Gerente de Testes
description:
Esta posição é responsável pela supervisão de testes de ponta a ponta, incluindo execução da estratégia, gerenciamento de recursos, coordenação com as partes interessadas, gerenciamento de riscos e relatórios de progresso.

O Gerente de Testes planeja, controla e aprimora continuamente as atividades de teste para garantir que o software e os sistemas integrados atendam aos padrões de qualidade definidos antes do lançamento. Isso inclui definir objetivos de qualidade, apoiar a automação de testes quando apropriado e garantir que as equipes compreendam claramente os processos de teste, controles e expectativas de governança.

Responsável por impulsionar práticas de teste consistentes e de alta qualidade em múltiplos projetos. A função garante um modelo de governança unificado, metodologias alinhadas e resultados de entrega previsíveis.



Principais Responsabilidades


• Definir, comunicar e garantir o cumprimento da estratégia geral de testes junto a todas as partes interessadas e equipes de entrega.

• Identificar, garantir e coordenar os recursos de teste alinhados ao escopo e aos marcos de entrega.

• Garantir que os ambientes de teste, os dados e as integrações de sistema estejam disponíveis e adequados à finalidade.

• Analisar e gerenciar defeitos, riscos e problemas decorrentes de todas as fases de teste.

Estabelecer e manter um repositório centralizado de cenários e ativos de teste.

• Identificar e reutilizar materiais de teste existentes para melhorar a eficiência e a consistência.

• Definir e finalizar o escopo de testes em conjunto com todas as áreas impactadas.

• Definir, preparar e validar os requisitos de dados de teste de acordo com o escopo acordado.

• Desenvolver planos detalhados de execução de testes diários, incluindo cenários de contingência e de menor prioridade.

• Definir e obter consenso sobre critérios claros de conclusão dos ciclos de teste.

• Identificar e gerenciar o escopo de testes de regressão para proteger a funcionalidade existente.


Requisitos

Profissional Senior, com experiência comprovada liderando iniciativas complexas de testes em sistemas de grande escala.

• Ampla experiência prática em testes de software e garantia de qualidade em ambientes corporativos.

• Capacidade comprovada de liderar, coordenar e motivar equipes de teste em múltiplos fluxos de trabalho.

• Sólida experiência em planejamento, escopo, estimativa e análise de testes.

• Excelentes habilidades de comunicação e colaboração com stakeholders em equipes de negócios e técnicas.

• Mentalidade analítica com forte capacidade de resolução de problemas e atenção aos detalhes.

• Experiência comprovada na definição, implementação e gestão de estratégias e planos de teste.

• Sólido conhecimento de modelos SDLC e uma ampla gama de metodologias de teste.

• Conhecimento prático de ferramentas, frameworks e melhores práticas de automação de testes.


Experiência Desejáveis

• Familiaridade com as plataformas SAP S/4HANA e Salesforce Lightning, incluindo módulos, aplicações e abordagens de entrega.

• Formação técnica com compreensão de integrações de sistemas e protocolos de interface.

• Experiência em planejamento e execução de testes de desempenho, carga e estresse.

• Forte experiência com modelos de entrega ágil e colaboração em equipes multifuncionais.

• Capacidade de análise de negócios, incluindo técnicas de levantamento e validação de requisitos.

• Experiência comprovada em TDD (Desenvolvimento Orientado a Testes).

• Experiência comprovada com Jira XRay, Selenium e Tricentis TTA

title: Talent Recruiter LATAM
description:
Job Title: Talent Recruiter (Influencers)

Company: DolFinContent LLC

Location: Remote

Employment Type: Full Time (Contractor)


About DolFinContent

DolFinContent LLC is a talent agency specializing in influencers, representing digital creators worldwide and connecting them with brands through strategic partnerships, sponsorships, and campaign opportunities. The agency focuses on long-term creator growth, brand alignment, and professional representation within the creator economy.


Position Overview

DolFinContent is seeking a Talent Recruiter to support the continued expansion of the agency’s influencer roster. This role focuses on identifying high-potential creators, conducting professional outreach, managing onboarding, and supporting talent relationship development. The ideal candidate is highly organized, proactive, detail-oriented, and passionate about social media, creator partnerships, and talent development.


Key Responsibilities

• Identify, source, and recruit influencers and digital creators across major social media platforms, including TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, Twitch, Kick, and emerging platforms

• Conduct professional outreach through social media platforms, email communication, and networking tools

• Manage the onboarding process for new creators, including agreements, internal documentation, and profile setup

• Build and maintain strong professional relationships with creators through consistent communication

• Maintain accurate internal databases, including talent rosters, creator profiles, and recruitment pipelines

• Research social media trends and identify emerging creators with strong growth potential

• Collaborate with Talent and Sales teams to support campaign opportunities and roster growth

• Track recruitment activity, outreach performance, and talent acquisition metrics

• Provide weekly recruitment reports and progress updates

• Support general talent operations and recruitment initiatives as needed


Skills and Qualifications

• Native or fluent English proficiency (written and verbal) is required

• Excellent organizational and time management abilities

• Strong attention to detail and ability to manage multiple priorities

• Interest in influencer marketing, talent management, recruiting, or digital media

• Ability to work independently in a remote environment

• Experience with Google Sheets, Excel, CRM systems, or outreach tools is preferred

• Previous experience in recruiting, talent sourcing, or influencer marketing is a plus


Compensation

• Base compensation of 1,000 USD per month

• Commission opportunities based on creators successfully recruited and onboarded

• Performance-based earning potential with growth opportunities


What We Offer

• Direct experience within the influencer marketing and talent management industry

• Opportunity to work with a growing global talent agency

• Professional development within talent acquisition and creator partnerships

• Remote work environment

• Performance-based growth opportunities


How to Apply

If you are passionate about social media, talent discovery, and relationship building, we encourage you to apply and join DolFinContent’s growing global team.

title: Analista de Dados Digitais (Tracking & Analytics)
description:
Sobre a THREAD


A THREAD é uma consultoria de tecnologia e engenharia de software que cresce de forma consistente, impulsionada pela entrega contínua de valor e pela confiança de grandes marcas.


Somos especialistas em desenvolver sistemas sob medida, conectando estratégia, dados e performance em cada solução.


Atuamos em parceria com empresas de diversos setores, entregando produtos digitais, integrações e plataformas que unem tecnologia à estratégia de negócio.


Descrição da vaga


Buscamos um Analista de Dados Digitais (Tracking & Analytics) para atuar 100% remoto, apoiando a estruturação, coleta e análise de dados em produtos digitais de clientes.


Você será responsável por garantir que os dados capturados reflitam corretamente o comportamento do usuário, apoiando decisões de produto, marketing e negócio.


Esperamos alguém organizado, analítico e com forte capacidade de execução, que consiga transformar necessidades de negócio em estruturas de tracking claras, confiáveis e escaláveis.


Responsabilidades


  • Estruturar e manter mapas de tags (tracking plan)
  • Realizar tagueamento via Google Tag Manager (GTM)
  • Apoiar o time de desenvolvimento na criação e validação de variáveis e eventos
  • Garantir a qualidade e consistência dos dados coletados
  • Criar e evoluir relatórios de acompanhamento no Looker Studio
  • Validar implementações de tracking (debug, testes e QA)
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com times técnicos e de produto para entender necessidades de mensuração
  • Documentar regras de tracking e estrutura de eventos
  • Identificar oportunidades de melhoria na coleta e uso de dados


Requisitos Obrigatórios


  • Experiência com Google Tag Manager (GTM)
  • Experiência com Google Analytics (GA4)
  • Conhecimento em estruturação de tracking (eventos, variáveis, dataLayer)
  • Experiência com Looker Studio (criação de dashboards)
  • Capacidade de estruturar mapas de mensuração (tracking plan)
  • Boa comunicação para interação com times técnicos (devs)
  • Perfil analítico e orientado a dados
  • Organização e atenção a detalhes
  • Capacidade de validar e garantir qualidade dos dados


Diferenciais


  • Experiência com ferramentas de BI como Qlik
  • Noções de HTML/CSS/JavaScript
  • Experiência com ferramentas como Hotjar, Firebase, etc.
  • Conhecimento em funil de conversão e métricas digitais
  • Experiência com testes A/B
  • Vivência em produtos digitais ou squads de tecnologia


Mindset esperado


  • Clareza e objetividade na comunicação
  • Forte senso de responsabilidade com dados e entregas
  • Organização e disciplina operacional
  • Autonomia para executar e destravar demandas
  • Capacidade de trabalhar com times técnicos
  • Foco em qualidade e confiabilidade da informação
  • Mentalidade analítica e orientada a impacto

This role is for the person who:

  • Wants to help founders of eCommerce brands scale with confidence through clean, reliable financials.
  • Enjoys leading talented accountants and delivering clarity and insights founders can rely on.
  • Thrives in a tech-forward, growing environment where continuous improvement is encouraged.


The salary range for this role is CA$ $ 3000–6000 p/m, depending on location and experience.

To support our continued growth, this is an active position we’re currently recruiting for.


About UpCounting

We’re a fully remote, tech-powered firm helping eCommerce and digital-first businesse s scale with confidence.

Our global team works asynchronously, giving everyone time for deep, meaningful focus.

title: Analista de Governança de Dados Sênior
description:
Você acredita que dados de qualidade são o alicerce para uma IA de sucesso? Sabe que governança não é burocracia, mas sim eficiência e confiança?


Na redspark , estamos em busca de um perfil sênior para transformar nossos instrumentos de governança em ferramentas vivas. Sua missão será garantir a integridade, a padronização e a rastreabilidade das informações que alimentam nossas maiores inovações.

  • Operacionalizar o Catálogo e Metadados: Implementar e gerir o catálogo para que datasets críticos sejam facilmente encontrados e compreendidos.

  • Guardião da Padronização: Auxiliar na organização de datasets prontos para Analytics e IA.

title: Salesforce CRM Specialist
description:
Position Overview:

As the Customer Relationship Management Specialist (CRM Specialist), you will support the day-to-day execution of the CRM function. You will be a key contributor in Salesforce Marketing Cloud (SFMC), partnering with Marketing, Operations, Contact Center, and Product to build and optimize journeys, automations, and campaigns that move clients from inquiry to booked appointment to loyal advocate.

This role sits within the Marketing team, working alongside peers across demand generation, digital performance, brand, and content.


Key Responsibilities:


Salesforce Marketing Cloud (SFMC):

Support the execution and optimization of campaigns within SFMC. Collaborate on building, testing, and deploying journeys and automations with a strong focus on the end-user experience and business impact.

Client Journey:

Assist in building and improving omnichannel journeys across email and SMS, supporting key moments from lead to booking to post-visit engagement, including reminders and follow-ups.

Data Segmentation and Hygiene:

Maintain audience segments and support data quality initiatives, including contact organization, suppression lists, and basic scoring logic to ensure a reliable database.

Testing & Quality Control:

Execute A/B tests on subject lines, send times, messaging, and journey logic. Document results and apply learnings to improve performance.

Performance & Reporting:

Support CRM reporting by tracking key metrics such as bookings, conversion rates, and engagement. Contribute to performance analysis and insights.

Operational Support:

Work cross-functionally with Marketing, Contact Center, and Product teams to identify and help resolve friction points in the client journey.

Platform Integrations:

Support the day-to-day functioning of SFMC in coordination with Salesforce CRM and other tools. Escalate issues and collaborate on solutions when needed.


Required Qualifications:

Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, or a related field (or equivalent professional experience)

3–5 years of experience in CRM, lifecycle marketing, or marketing automation roles, including Salesforce Marketing Cloud



Preferred Qualifications:

Salesforce Marketing Cloud certification

Working knowledge of Salesforce CRM

Experience in multi-location services, retail, or health and wellness industries

Familiarity with booking or practice management systems

Experience with SMS marketing and omnichannel engagement

Basic understanding of Martech integrations and data structures

Experience creating or adapting content to improve engagement across the client lifecycle
