title: Infrastructure Engineer
description:
ITTConnect is seeking an Infrastructure Engineer to work remotely from anywhere in Brazil for a client in the US.


MUST BE fluent in English.


The Infrastructure Engineer is responsible for supporting and maintaining customer IT infrastructure within the Managed Services environment. This role focuses on resolving technical issues, supporting backend infrastructure systems, and collaborating with customer IT teams to deploy and maintain solutions. Infrastructure Engineers combine technical troubleshooting with proactive monitoring and documentation to ensure stable and secure client environments.


Key Responsibilities


  • Troubleshoot and resolve technical issues related to servers, virtualization, storage, and core infrastructure systems.
  • Serve as an escalation point for the IT Support team on complex infrastructure-related incidents.
  • Work directly with customers and their IT teams to support the deployment, configuration, and maintenance of infrastructure solutions.
  • Investigate alerts and system reports to proactively identify potential infrastructure issues and performance risks.
  • Follow established runbooks, procedures, and architectural documentation to resolve incidents.
  • Exercise sound technical judgment when diagnosing and resolving infrastructure issues that may not have predefined solutions.
  • Assist with the creation and maintenance of runbooks, diagrams, and infrastructure documentation.
  • Participate in system maintenance activities such as upgrades, patching, and system health checks.
  • Document incident resolution steps and system changes within internal ticketing and knowledge management systems.
  • Maintain strong communication with internal teams and customers regarding issue status and resolution timelines.



Requirements

  • 8+ years of IT experience.
  • MUST BE fluent in English.
  • 3–6 years of experience supporting IT infrastructure in an MSP, enterprise IT, or hosting environment.
  • Experience with Windows or Linux server administration.
  • Experience with virtualization platforms (VMware, Hyper-V, etc.).
  • Familiarity with storage, backup, and disaster recovery systems.
  • Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills.
  • Experience working within ticketing systems and following structured support processes.
  • Strong documentation and communication skills.

Preferred

  • Certifications such as VMware VCP, Microsoft, or cloud infrastructure certifications.
  • Experience working in a Managed Service Provider (MSP) environment with exposure to ITIL-based service delivery models.
  • Experience with enterprise infrastructure technologies including VMware vSphere, Cisco UCS, and Citrix Virtual Apps and Desktops (CVAD).
  • Cloud platform administration experience; Google Cloud Platform (GCP) and Amazon Web Services (AWS) are preferred.
  • Experience with cloud platforms, particularly Google Cloud Platform (GCP), including infrastructure design, administration, and troubleshooting.
  • Administration experience with Cisco Unified Communications Manager (CUCM), and enterprise storage platforms.
  • Familiarity with identity platforms (Active Directory, Okta), firewalls (Palo Alto, Cisco FTD), and backup/disaster recovery solutions is a plus.

title: Desenvolvedor Java/Angular FullStack
description:
DESCRIÇÃO DA VAGA

Somos aproximadamente 50k Minsaiters no Mundo e mais de 9k Minsaiters no Brasil e estamos presentes nas maiores empresas em todos os setores. Nossa estrutura permite participar de projetos globais e proporciona um ambiente colaborativo que nos certifica em GreatPlacesToWork e planos diferenciados para Jovens Profissionais também reconhecidos pela Employers for Youth.


Você atuará no nosso time de Desenvolvimento em um projeto estratégico, utilizando metodologias ágeis e em um ambiente de inovação.

Buscamos profissionais com senso de dono, comprometidos com o sucesso do nosso cliente e com o desenvolvimento da sua carreira dentro da Minsait

Você será um pilar fundamental nos melhores e maiores projetos de TI do Brasil e em nível global.



Venha ser um Minsaiter!


RESPONSABILIDADES E ATRIBUIÇÕES


  • Desenvolver e manter aplicações web de grande porte utilizando Java 8+ e Angular 11+ ;
  • Construir e evoluir APIs REST , garantindo boas práticas de arquitetura, segurança e performance;
  • Atuar na modelagem e persistência de dados em bancos relacionais (SQL Server e DB2 );
  • Trabalhar com frameworks de persistência como Hibernate/JPA e EJB3 ;
  • Garantir a qualidade do código por meio de testes unitários (JUnit) e ferramentas de análise (ex: Sonar);
  • Participar de processos de integração contínua e entrega contínua (CI/CD) utilizando ferramentas como Jenkins, Nexus e Git;
  • Documentar serviços e APIs utilizando Swagger ;
  • Desenvolver e manter relatórios com Jasper Reports ;
  • Colaborar com times multidisciplinares em ambiente ágil (Scrum/Kanban );
  • Contribuir na análise de requisitos e definição de soluções técnicas;
  • Atuar com tecnologias legadas quando necessário (ex: Flash Builder ).


REQUISITOS E QUALIFICAÇÕES


  • Experiência sólida como Desenvolvedor Fullstack (nível sênior);
  • Forte conhecimento em Java 8 ou superior ;
  • Experiência com desenvolvimento front-end utilizando Angular (versão 11 ou superior) ;
  • Vivência na construção e consumo de APIs REST ;
  • Experiência com Hibernate ou JPA ;
  • Conhecimento em banco de dados relacional (SQL Server e/ou DB2 );
  • Experiência com EJB3 ;
  • Prática com versionamento de código utilizando Git ;
  • Experiência com testes unitários (JUnit) ;
  • Conhecimento em CI/CD (ex: Jenkins);
  • Vivência com metodologias ágeis (Scrum ou Kanban ).





Se você possui a experiência e as habilidades necessárias para se destacar como Desenvolvedor Java/Angular FullStack, candidate-se! ✨ Aguardamos ansiosamente para conhecer você e discutir como sua expertise pode contribuir para o sucesso de nossa equipe!

title: Desenvolvedor Front-end Pleno (Next.js + React)
description:

A THREAD é uma consultoria de tecnologia e engenharia de software que cresce de forma consistente, impulsionada pela entrega contínua de valor e pela confiança de grandes marcas.

  • Domínio de Zustand ou Redux Toolkit

title: Full Stack Engineer
description:
Senior Full-Stack Engineer (AI-Driven Platforms)

About the Role

We are looking for a Senior Full-Stack Engineer with strong experience designing, building, and scaling modern web applications and SaaS platforms. In this role, you will work across the entire stack, from intuitive frontend interfaces to robust backend services, cloud infrastructure, and AI-powered solutions. You will collaborate closely with product, engineering, and platform teams to deliver high-impact, scalable systems.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and scale full-stack web applications and SaaS platforms
  • Build high-quality, maintainable frontend experiences using modern frameworks
  • Develop APIs and backend services with a focus on performance, security, and scalability
  • Architect and manage cloud-native infrastructure using Infrastructure as Code
  • Implement AI-powered features using foundation models and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) architectures
  • Ensure reliability through automated testing, CI/CD pipelines, and observability best practices
  • Collaborate in English on a daily basis with cross-functional and international teams

Technical Requirements

Frontend

  • Strong experience with TypeScript, React, and Next.js
  • Proficiency with modern CSS frameworks such as Tailwind CSS

Backend

  • Solid experience with Node.js (Express and/or NestJS) and/or Python (FastAPI or Django)

Databases

  • Experience with relational databases such as PostgreSQL or AWS Aurora
  • Experience with Vector Data Stores (Amazon OpenSearch Serverless, pgvector, or Pinecone)

Cloud & Infrastructure

  • Deep familiarity with AWS (Lambda, ECS/EKS, S3, API Gateway) or GCP
  • Strong experience with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform or AWS CDK)

AI & Orchestration

  • Hands-on experience with Amazon Bedrock (working with foundation models like Claude or Llama)
  • Experience with Google Vertex AI
  • Familiarity with LangChain, LlamaIndex, and RAG architectures

DevOps & CI/CD

  • Experience with Docker and GitLab CI
  • Strong knowledge of observability and monitoring tools such as Datadog, AWS CloudWatch, Google Cloud Monitoring, and Google Cloud Logging

Testing

  • Experience with automated testing frameworks such as Jest, PyTest, Playwright, or Cypress

Developer Tools

  • Advanced proficiency with AI coding assistants such as Cursor, GitLab Duo, and Claude Code

Language Requirements

  • Advanced English proficiency for daily communication


Igualdade & Oportunidade para Todos

Representando 165 nacionalidades em todo o mundo, nos orgulhamos de ser um empregador que oferece igualdade de oportunidades, comprometido em fornecer oportunidades iguais de emprego a todos os candidatos e funcionários, independentemente de raça, religião, sexo, cor, idade, nacionalidade, gravidez, orientação sexual, deficiência física ou informações genéticas, ou qualquer outra classificação protegida, de acordo com as leis federais, estaduais e/ou locais.

title: Local Assistant (Brazil/Remote)
description:
Assistente Local - Brasil

【Sobre a Nossa Empresa】  Somos uma empresa global de jogos móveis  dedicada a criar experiências de entretenimento inovadoras em todo o mundo. Estamos em rápida expansão no mercado da América Latina e buscamos talentos locais para crescer conosco.


【Principais Tarefas】

  • Produção de Conteúdo : Gerenciar a equipe de filmagem local, sendo responsável por todo o processo, desde a busca de atores e criação de roteiros até a entrega final dos vídeos.
  • Expansão de Recursos : Identificar e entrar em contato com streamers de jogos e entretenimento (KOL/KOC) no Brasil, avaliando e fechando parcerias.
  • Tendências Locais : Acompanhar feriados, cultura e tendências das redes sociais no Brasil para fornecer sugestões criativas para o produto.


【Requisitos】

  • Idioma : Nível profissional de Português. Conhecimento básico de Chinês ou Inglês é altamente desejável.
  • Interesses : Entusiasta de jogos eletrônicos e redes sociais.


【Benefícios e Condições】

  • Local de trabalho : 100% Remoto (Home Office).
  • Salário : 7.000 - 10.000 BRL por mês.
  • Horário : Das 14:00 às 23:30 (horário de Brasília), com 1,5h de intervalo. Folgas aos fins de semana.

【Sobre a Nossa Empresa】  Somos uma empresa global de jogos móveis  dedicada a criar experiências de entretenimento inovadoras em todo o mundo. Estamos em rápida expansão no mercado da América Latina e buscamos talentos locais para crescer conosco.

  • Produção de Conteúdo : Gerenciar a equipe de filmagem local, sendo responsável por todo o processo, desde a busca de atores e criação de roteiros até a entrega final dos vídeos.

【Benefícios e Condições】

  • Local de trabalho : 100% Remoto (Home Office).
  • Salário : 7.000 - 10.000 BRL por mês.
  • Horário : Das 14:00 às 23:30 (horário de Brasília), com 1,5h de intervalo. Folgas aos fins de semana.


Local Assistant - Brazil

【About Us】  We are a global mobile gaming company  committed to delivering top-tier entertainment experiences worldwide. We are actively expanding our footprint across Latin America and looking for passionate local talents to join our journey.


【Core Tasks】

  • Salary : 7,000 - 10,000 BRL/month.
  • Working Hours : 14:00 - 23:30 (Local Time) with a 1.5-hour break. Weekends off.

title: Palestrante Executivo em Tecnologia e Inovação
description:

Sobre a oportunidade:


Buscamos um profissional com forte conhecimento em Tecnologia, Inteligência Artificial e Cloud Computing , que atue como referência técnica e representante da empresa em eventos, reuniões estratégicas e interações com clientes de alta gestão.

Essa posição conecta conhecimento técnico profundo com excelente capacidade de comunicação , contribuindo tanto para posicionamento de mercado quanto para geração de oportunidades de negócio.


Principais responsabilidades

  • Representar a empresa em eventos, palestras e encontros com clientes em todo o Brasil
  • Atuar como porta-voz técnico em temas relacionados a IA, Cloud e inovação
  • Conduzir apresentações executivas para stakeholders e alta liderança
  • Apoiar o time comercial na construção de soluções e geração de oportunidades

  • Contribuir com posicionamento de mercado e autoridade da empresa

  • Forte conhecimento em Tecnologia, com foco em Inteligência Artificial e Cloud Computing
  • Experiência prévia em apresentações, palestras ou ensino (diferencial importante)

  • Vivência em interações com clientes e/ou ambientes corporativos

title: Partner Success Manager
description:
Sobre a vaga

O(a) Partner Success Manager atuará em estreita colaboração com equipes internas e organizações parceiras de serviços para assegurar resultados de alta qualidade. Trata-se de uma excelente oportunidade para ajudar a definir e expandir uma função que impacta diretamente o desempenho das entregas, ao mesmo tempo em que desenvolve a capacidade de longo prazo dos parceiros.


Principais responsabilidades

• Garantir que os parceiros entreguem valor mensurável e dentro do prazo aos clientes, tanto na implementação quanto ao longo da jornada do cliente.

• Manter visibilidade sobre o progresso das implementações dos parceiros, atuando de forma transversal para acelerar entregas e assegurar o cumprimento de marcos.

• Identificar riscos de forma proativa, reduzir fricções e gerenciar escalonamentos, facilitando planos de recuperação (“path to green”) e engajando as partes envolvidas para resolução de problemas.

• Garantir que os escalonamentos sejam monitorados, tratados com urgência e reportados de forma adequada.

• Colaborar com a área de Enablement para avaliar a prontidão e o alinhamento dos parceiros.

• Impulsionar o desenvolvimento de capacidades dos parceiros por meio de atividades estruturadas de capacitação e oportunidades de shadowing.

• Atuar em conjunto com as áreas de Delivery, Suporte, Produto e Cloud para otimizar o suporte às implementações.

• Capturar e reportar resultados de entrega, tendências de escalonamento e indicadores de prontidão.

• Contribuir para o desenvolvimento de playbooks, procedimentos operacionais padrão (SOPs) e frameworks de sucesso de parceiros.


Qualificações essenciais

• Mais de 2 anos de experiência em suporte à entrega, operações com parceiros, customer success, coordenação de projetos ou áreas correlatas.

• Forte organização e atenção aos detalhes.

• Excelentes habilidades de comunicação e gestão de stakeholders.

• Capacidade de atuar de forma autônoma em ambientes multifuncionais.


Desejáveis

• Experiência com ferramentas de acompanhamento de projetos ou tickets (ex.: Jira, ServiceNow, Zendesk).

• Vivência com programas de ecossistema de parceiros ou governança de entregas.

• Proficiência em idiomas conforme a região (ver variações regionais).

title: Websphere Consultant
description:
Contractor (PJ)

Salary - 3k - 5400 USD pe month


Must Haves

  • 5+ years of experience (Senior)
  • Hands-on administrative experience with IBM WebSphere Application Server
  • Proven background in DevOps, Site Reliability, or Systems Administration
  • Strong ability to troubleshoot independently using application/server logs and monitoring tools
  • Experience supporting lower environments (Dev, QA, Staging)

Plusses

  • Analyze application and server logs to resolve issues like disk space alerts, memory constraints, and instability
  • Trigger and monitor existing CI/CD pipelines for deployments and environment management
  • Ensure overall stability and reliability of lower environments

title: Gestor de tráfego pago
description:
A Dropservice é a base por trás do crescimento de um ecossistema de marcas. Conectamos pessoas, processos e dados para que nossas marcas cresçam com clareza, eficiência e impacto nos maiores marketplaces do mundo.


Estamos em busca de um(a) Gestor(a) de Tráfego. Não é necessário ter experiência com Amazon. Procuramos alguém altamente capacitado(a) em tráfego pago (Google, Meta e outras plataformas), com mentalidade orientada a performance e disposição para dar o próximo passo na carreira dominando o Amazon Ads por dentro .

Se você é comunicativo(a), proativo(a), curioso(a), apaixonado(a) por aprendizado contínuo e não espera as oportunidades chegarem até você , queremos conversar com você.


Etapa obrigatória do processo


ANTES de finalizar sua candidatura pelo LinkedIn , preencha o formulário abaixo. Ele é obrigatório para que seu perfil seja considerado no processo seletivo e nos permite conduzir a análise com mais agilidade, clareza e transparência.

Acesse aqui:

(Caso o link não apareça clicável, copie e cole o endereço diretamente no seu navegador.)

Importante: candidaturas sem o formulário preenchido não serão consideradas para análise.


O que você vai fazer

  • Aprender e atuar com Amazon Ads, com suporte e treinamento interno — vamos te ensinar o jeito Amazon de fazer.
  • Gerenciar e otimizar campanhas de tráfego pago.
  • Criar, testar e refinar estratégias de segmentação, criativos e estruturas de campanha com foco em ROAS, CPA e lucratividade.

Oportunidade de crescimento

  • Você terá contato direto com sócios e liderança, compreendendo a estratégia do negócio além do gerenciador de anúncios.
  • Terá espaço para testar ideias, propor melhorias e acompanhar o impacto direto das suas campanhas em vendas reais.
  • Vai se desenvolver em Amazon Ads, um dos canais que mais cresce no Brasil e no mundo.
  • Ambiente com cultura forte de aprendizado contínuo, feedback direto e crescimento baseado em resultados — não em tempo de casa.

Perfil ideal

  • Atua como gestor(a) de tráfego ou analista de mídia paga.
  • Tem mentalidade de performance, não apenas de execução.
  • É comunicativo(a), proativo(a) e trabalha bem de forma autônoma.
  • Gosta de aprender e se manter atualizado(a); faz anotações com frequência e quer crescer como profissional de performance.

Experiência com Amazon Ads não é obrigatória — vamos te ensinar tudo sobre a plataforma. O que esperamos é uma base sólida em tráfego pago e muita vontade de aprender.

Requisitos obrigatórios

  • Experiência prática com tráfego pago (Google Ads, Meta Ads ou similar).
  • Capacidade de analisar métricas e tomar decisões orientadas por dados.
  • Boa comunicação escrita e verbal.
  • Organização para registrar testes, alterações e resultados.
  • Disponibilidade para atuar como PJ, em regime 100% remoto, em período integral.

Diferenciais

  • Experiência com e-commerce, lançamentos ou vendas online.
  • Histórico de atuação em ambientes com metas de resultado (ROAS, CPA, faturamento ou lucro).
  • Qualquer experiência prévia com Amazon Ads será considerada um diferencial, ainda que não seja obrigatória.


Como será o processo seletivo


  • Preenchimento do forms – ANTES de finalizar a candidatura no LinkedIn.
  • Análise do forms + triagem de currículo.
  • Aplicação do teste DISC.
  • Entrevista por vídeo com o time.
  • Feedback final (aprovado ou não) após a entrevista.


Modelo de trabalho


 Contratação: PJ – responsabilidade nas entregas e resultados, não nas horas.

 Local: 100% remoto.

 Faixa salarial: R$ 2.000,00 a R$ 3.000,00 (PJ) – de acordo com experiência e nível técnico.

title: IT Business Analyst
description:
IT Business Analyst – Sao Paulo / Hybrid - Fluent French & English

(IT Business Analyst, Technical Business Analyst, IT BA, Technical BA)


Our client is an exciting and cutting-edge fintech giant with a global presence. They have been a market leader within the fintech consultancy sector for many years and their worldwide client base has never been stronger, with significant growth in the last 12 months. They are looking for an experienced IT Business Analyst with a technical background to play a pivotal part in shaping customer solutions, supporting discovery, mapping requirements, designing integrations, and ensuring high-quality delivery across multiple projects.


As an experienced IT Business Analyst, you will be responsible for providing architectural oversight across multiple concurrent implementations and leading architectural discovery sessions with customer stakeholders. This will include designing end-to-end solution architectures across SaaS platforms, APIs, middleware, CRM, eCommerce, and Order Management systems.


Expert knowledge of solution design, application and infrastructure planning is essential, as is experience in technical software implementation for Enterprise level customers. Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills are a must, as you will be building collaborative partnerships with key customer stakeholders. You will also need to have excellent time and priority management skills that enable you to work in different time zones and speak and write fluently in French and English. The use of AI to expedite tasks is also expected.


We are keen to hear from talented IT Business Analyst candidates from all backgrounds.


This is a truly amazing opportunity to work for a prestigious brand that will do wonders for your career. They invest heavily in training and career development; top performers are guaranteed a career path into senior and lead positions within 12 months.


Location: Sao Paulo / Hybrid

Salary: 160k BRL – 190k BRL + Bonus + Pension + Excellent Benefits

Languages: Fluent in French and English


To apply for this position please send your CV to Karan Gajjar at Noir Consulting.

title: Business Development Representative
description:
Job Title: Business Development Representative

Company: DolFinContent LLC

Location: Remote

Employment Type: Full Time (Contractor)


About DolFinContent

DolFinContent LLC is a talent agency specializing in influencers, representing digital creators worldwide and connecting them with brands through strategic partnerships, sponsorships, and campaign opportunities. The agency focuses on long-term creator growth, brand alignment, and professional representation within the creator economy.


Position Overview

DolFinContent is seeking a Business Development Representative to support the continued expansion of the agency’s influencer roster. This role focuses on identifying high-potential creators, conducting professional outreach, managing onboarding, and supporting talent relationship development. The ideal candidate is highly organized, proactive, detail-oriented, and passionate about social media, creator partnerships, and talent development.


Key Responsibilities

• Identify, source, and recruit influencers and digital creators across major social media platforms, including TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, Twitch, Kick, and emerging platforms

• Conduct professional outreach through social media platforms, email communication, and networking tools

• Manage the onboarding process for new creators, including agreements, internal documentation, and profile setup

• Build and maintain strong professional relationships with creators through consistent communication

• Maintain accurate internal databases, including talent rosters, creator profiles, and recruitment pipelines

• Research social media trends and identify emerging creators with strong growth potential

• Collaborate with Talent and Sales teams to support campaign opportunities and roster growth

• Track recruitment activity, outreach performance, and talent acquisition metrics

• Provide weekly recruitment reports and progress updates

• Support general talent operations and recruitment initiatives as needed


Skills and Qualifications

• Native or fluent English proficiency (written and verbal) is required

• Excellent organizational and time management abilities

• Strong attention to detail and ability to manage multiple priorities

• Interest in influencer marketing, talent management, recruiting, or digital media

• Ability to work independently in a remote environment

• Experience with Google Sheets, Excel, CRM systems, or outreach tools is preferred

• Previous experience in recruiting, talent sourcing, or influencer marketing is a plus


Compensation

• Base compensation of 1,000 USD per month

• Commission opportunities based on creators successfully recruited and onboarded

• Performance-based earning potential with growth opportunities


What We Offer

• Direct experience within the influencer marketing and talent management industry

• Opportunity to work with a growing global talent agency

• Professional development within talent acquisition and creator partnerships

• Remote work environment

• Performance-based growth opportunities


How to Apply

If you are passionate about social media, talent discovery, and relationship building, we encourage you to apply and join DolFinContent’s growing global team.

title: Senior Ruby on Rails Engineer
description:
About StayFi

StayFi combines IoT and marketing technology for the vacation rental industry (think Airbnb hosts). With our product, vacation rental managers can create a meshable WiFi guest network with a custom-branded WiFi login page that collects guest information. Our software lets them monitor their network remotely and integrates with their marketing tools to help them build relationships with their guests and grow their business.


Over the past 8 years, we’ve built our business from the ground up without the help of large investors. This means we’re growing a sustainable business and we run it independently. We’re a small team so each team member has a big impact on our product and business. And we’re creating tools that our customers truly love.


About You
  • You're a senior full stack Ruby on Rails developer with 7+ years of professional experience building and shipping production applications.
  • You're a product-minded engineer who takes ownership. You think beyond each task / ticket and consider the broader impact of your technical decisions on the business.
  • You write expressive, readable, and maintainable code and hold yourself and others to a high standard through thoughtful code reviews.
  • You have a strong command of Rails conventions but know when and how to diverge from them pragmatically.
  • You're comfortable navigating and improving legacy codebases, not just greenfield projects.
  • You're curious about IoT, WiFi, and building sophisticated 3rd party API integrations.

  • You're energized by working on a small team where your decisions carry real weight.


About the Role
  • Write full stack code using Ruby on Rails, PostgreSQL, Tailwind CSS, React and JavaScript, and deploy it via Heroku, Azure and AWS.
  • Take ownership of large, complex projects: from scoping and architecture through to delivery in close collaboration with the CTO.
  • Identify and address performance bottlenecks, technical debt, and architectural weaknesses proactively.
  • Build and maintain robust API integrations with 3rd party software providers.
  • Lead by example in pull request culture; writing clear descriptions, giving constructive feedback, and raising the bar for the whole team.

  • Contribute to engineering standards, tooling decisions, and best practices as a senior voice on the team.


Why Work at StayFi?
  • You'll work directly with the CTO and CEO on mission-critical projects with real ownership and autonomy.
  • Your experience and judgment will directly shape the technical direction of the product.
  • You'll have an outsized impact both within our company and across the vacation rental industry  in a way that's rarely possible at larger organizations.
  • As you continue to help our business grow, you can expect increases in your salary or hourly rate.

  • You'll gain visibility into the full lifecycle of a sustainable, founder-led business well beyond just writing code.

title: Jr Partnerships Specialist
description:
We are looking for a full-time, remote Partnership Programs Specialist with a strong communication skills and background in sales to join our U.S. client. The right candidates will play a vital role in supporting and executing partnership initiatives that drive growth and value for our client. Reporting to the Director of Partnerships, this role focuses on coordinating and implementing partnership programs, ensuring seamless execution and alignment with strategic goals.

The Partner Programs Specialist is responsible for providing accurate information about the company and its services. The specialist is required to keep accurate records of all time spent on calls, as well as customer-related questions or assistance. All phone calls are recorded.

Our client is on a mission provide technology and services that enable veterinary practices to provide the highest quality of care to pet owners. The company is well-funded, growth-stage company comprising individuals that thrive in a fast-paced, passionate, and entrepreneurial environment. Our client has thousands (and counting) of veterinarians within its customer base today.


Responsibilities

  • Engage with customers and prospects via phone, email, and messaging to generate sales
  • Leveraging various platforms and tools such as Salesforce, Salesloft, Chorus, Chili Piper, and more

  • Meet and exceed monthly goals
  • Work with multiple internal teams to ensure that the customer experience is seamless


Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication skills
  • 1-3 years of call center sales or remote sales experience
  • Highly motivated with a strong sense of ambition, self-discipline, and a commitment to both personal and professional development
  • Confident, energetic, and skilled communicator
  • Team player, who excels in cross-departmental collaboration
  • Driven by a competitive spirit and a passion for success!
  • Commitment to constant learning and continual growth as our client builds a better veterinary experience together, and are looking for people who will make our culture and technology even better
  • A collaborative approach, a can-do attitude, and a relentless pursuit to attain goals and solve problems
  • Trustworthy, team-oriented, and transparent


Desired Experience

  • Experience working in the veterinary space and/or sales


Additional Information

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with smart and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Lets learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!

About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent that enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued client team members. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: Especialista Técnico SAP I
description:
No Grupo SBF, reunimos duas grandes forças do esporte no Brasil: a Centauro, maior varejista esportiva multimarcas da América Latina, e a Fisia, distribuidora oficial da Nike no país.


Queremos ser referência em esporte no Brasil e construir um futuro em que cada experiência com o esporte inspire, motive e transforme.


E aí, que tal vestir essa camisa com a gente?


Responsabilidades e atribuições


  • Arquitetura e Governança de Soluções (Keep the Core Clean): Atuar como autoridade técnica e ponto focal para decisões de design em ambientes ABAP e SAP BTP. Garantir a integridade do sistema através da estratégia Keep the Core Clean, definindo padrões de arquitetura (In-app e Side-by-side) que assegurem a escalabilidade e a facilidade de futuras atualizações do ERP.
  • Liderança Técnica e Excelência em Engenharia : Liderar a squad técnica estabelecendo e zelando por padrões de alta performance, segurança e qualidade de código (Clean ABAP). Realizar Code Reviews críticos e auditorias técnicas para garantir que as entregas do time (interno ou terceirizado) estejam alinhadas às melhores práticas de desenvolvimento.
  • Inovação e Modernização do Ecossistema : Direcionar a adoção de tecnologias de ponta e novos modelos de programação, como SAP Fiori, RAP (Restful ABAP Programming Model) e CAP (Cloud Application Programming Model). Identificar oportunidades de inovação tecnológica que transformem processos de negócio em soluções digitais eficientes.
  • Interface Estratégica e Tradução de Negócio : Atuar como facilitador entre as áreas funcionais, Gerentes de Projetos e o time técnico. Traduzir requisitos de negócio complexos em especificações técnicas viáveis, garantindo que as expectativas dos stakeholders sejam atendidas com soluções tecnicamente sustentáveis.
  • Gestão do Ciclo de Vida e Mentoria : Supervisionar o ciclo de vida completo das soluções (do desenho técnico ao deploy e sustentação). Atuar como mentor técnico da equipe, promovendo a disseminação de conhecimento, resolvendo gargalos complexos e elevando o nível de senioridade técnica do time.
  • Ambiente Tecnológico e Desafio: Atuar em um ecossistema (Híbrido / Cloud) de alta criticidade, sendo o guardião da transição tecnológica de legados ABAP para modelos modernos no SAP S/4HANA. O escopo abrange desde o refinamento técnico de melhorias contínuas até a liderança técnica em projetos estruturantes de inovação e integração via SAP BTP.
  • Funcionais e Negócio : Parceria direta com consultores funcionais (MM, SD, FI, CO, etc.) e BPs para traduzir dores operacionais em arquiteturas técnicas robustas.
  • Desenvolvimentos e Projetos: Interface com Gerentes de Projeto e Funcionais para definição de cronogramas técnicos, estimativas de esforço e priorização de backlogs baseada em viabilidade e impacto.
  • Metas Estratégicas do Cargo : Modernização do Core: Atingir KPIs de redução de customizações \"Z\" tradicionais em favor de extensões Side-by-Side e otimização do consumo de serviços no SAP BTP para evitar custos excedentes.
  • Qualidade e Estabilidade : Redução do Lead Time de desenvolvimento e diminuição de incidentes em PRD causados por falhas de transporte ou performance.
  • Nível de Maturidade Técnica : Elevar a proficiência do time em tecnologias como RAP, CAP e Fiori através de programas de mentoria interna.


Requisitos e qualificações


  • Ecossistema SAP: Experiência sólida e comprovada em projetos de alta complexidade, com protagonismo técnico. Domínio prático na arquitetura de extensibilidade via SAP BTP e integrações nativas em nuvem.
  • Domínio de Desenvolvimento Moderno: Vivência profunda em programação ABAP (Standard e OO) em versões 7.5+; Utilização do Eclipse (ADT) e CDS Views.
  • Experiência com Extensibilidade e Cloud: Experiência prática na construção de extensões e integrações utilizando SAP BTP (Business Technology Platform).
  • Histórico de Liderança Técnica: Experiência prévia atuando como referência técnica (Tech Lead), sendo responsável por arquitetura de software, revisão de código (Code Review) e mentoria de desenvolvedores menos experientes.
  • Vivência em Metodologias Ágeis: Experiência de atuação em ambientes dinâmicos utilizando Scrum ou Kanban.

title: Senior Data Engineer - GCP
description:
You will be working for a US-based technology company with the leading Software, Web and mobile app development for business in North America helping independent retailers adopt and embrace this new key component of their digital marketing solution. We build and maintain thousands of retailer websites that must run reliably, efficiently, and effectively.

We only want the best and if you are looking to work with a fast growing and stable American company then this position is for you. We offer some of the best benefits and compensation available in the market for talented and energetic people:


The Responsibilities

  • Design and implement robust, scalable backend services in Node.js, Python, and other technologies to process and deliver real-time and batch data for analytics, personalization, and search Integrate new data sources and improve existing ones using many different methods
  • Architect and manage cloud-native data infrastructure on GCP (e.g., BigQuery, Dataflow, Pub/Sub, Cloud Storage) Work primarily in Node JS for data extraction and transformation
  • Build and optimize data orchestration and deployment pipelines using Kubernetes and modern CI/CD tooling
  • Partner with frontend teams to expose data via internal dashboards, admin tools, and customer-facing components
  • Ensure data reliability, availability, and security across all services and systems
  • Collaborate with data scientists, analysts, and other engineers to build tools that unlock business insights from large-scale data
  • Help define data governance, quality, and observability standards
  • FinOps exposure/execution - you will have a lead role on a small team in cost auditing existing cloud infrastructure in GCP and proposing and collaborating on engineering changes needed to optimize cloud spends
  • Mentor other engineers and contribute to a culture of technical excellence and continuous learning


The Requirements

  • 8+ years of experience in backend or platform engineering, with a focus on data-intensive systems
  • Strong experience with Node.js and modern JavaScript/TypeScript development
  • Deep hands-on experience with Google Cloud Platform, including BigQuery, Pub/Sub, Cloud Functions, and GKE
  • Proficient in Kubernetes for deploying and scaling data services
  • Working knowledge of React for integrating backend systems with internal tools or dashboards
  • Solid understanding of data modeling, pipelines, and streaming architectures
  • Experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines for data applications
  • Strong experience working with Google Cloud Platform (GCP) – BigQuery, Dataflow, Pub/Sub, Cloud Storage, Kubernetes
  • Experience with FinOps best practices and auditing procedures
  • Strong understanding of deduplication to optimize data storage and reduce cloud costs
  • Strong English communication skills

description:
Somos o ecossistema de turismo mais transformador na vida de cada pessoa! A paixão por viagens está em nosso DNA.


Nossos escritórios proporcionam um ambiente moderno e pensado para uma melhor experiência de trabalho presencial. Somos múltiplos e diversos, gostamos de trabalhar com gente do bem, de forma inteligente, prática, ousada, inovadora e com tudo isso, buscamos o extraordinário.


O que nos move é a transformação e nosso lema é criar caminhos além do imaginável! Isso nos torna BeFly. E aí, você vem com a gente?

Estamos em busca de um(a) profissional para atuar como referência funcional e evolutiva do ERP Benner Turismo, garantindo estabilidade operacional, evolução do produto e alinhamento entre negócio, tecnologia e fornecedores. Papel híbrido, com forte atuação como Product Owner, priorizando backlog, melhorias e entregas de valor.


Principais responsabilidades:

  • Ser o ponto focal do ERP Benner (módulos financeiros, faturamento, conciliação, backoffice e integrações).
  • Atuar como Product Owner do produto, com gestão de backlog, priorização e roadmap.
  • Levantar e traduzir necessidades do negócio em requisitos funcionais claros.
  • Conduzir refinamentos, homologações e apoiar testes (UAT).
  • Garantir qualidade das entregas, estabilidade e aderência aos processos do negócio.
  • Interface direta com áreas usuárias, fornecedores (Benner) e times técnicos.
  • Apoiar projetos de automação, melhorias contínuas e integrações (APIs, arquivos, RPA).
  • Monitorar indicadores, riscos e impactos operacionais.


Requisitos e qualificações:

  • Experiência sólida com ERP Benner (preferencialmente Benner Turismo).
  • Vivência em áreas financeiras/administrativas e processos de backoffice.
  • Atuação prévia ou forte aderência ao papel de Product Owner.
  • Boa comunicação, organização e capacidade de priorização.
  • Perfil hands-on, colaborativo e orientado a entrega.
  • Experiência com projetos, backlog, indicadores e condução de demandas com múltiplos stakeholders.

title: BDR (Business Development Representative)
description:
About Foundey

Foundey is a strategic UI/UX design agency specializing in supporting SaaS, AI, and tech startups. Our mission is to help startups create user experiences that match their potential through design that connects user behavior to business success. We partner closely with founders to deliver high-impact design solutions—from MVP design sprints to full-scale product interface design and UX audits.


The Opportunity

We’re looking for a proactive, hands on and results-driven Business Development Representative (BDR) to help expand Foundey’s pipeline of high-quality startup clients. In this role, you’ll be responsible for identifying, engaging, and qualifying potential customers—primarily founders and decision-makers in SaaS, AI, and tech companies.

You’ll play a critical role in connecting innovative startups with design solutions that drive real business outcomes. This is a great opportunity for someone who thrives in fast-paced environments and enjoys building relationships from the ground up.


Key Responsibilities

  • Identify and research potential clients within SaaS, AI, and tech startup ecosystems
  • Conduct outbound prospecting via email, LinkedIn, and other channels
  • Qualify inbound and outbound leads to assess fit and readiness
  • Schedule and coordinate discovery calls for the sales or leadership team
  • Build and maintain a healthy pipeline of opportunities
  • Collaborate with marketing and design teams to refine outreach messaging
  • Track activities and performance using CRM tools
  • Continuously optimize outreach strategies based on results and feedback


Qualifications

  • 3 years+ of experience in sales, business development, or lead generation (preferably in SaaS or agency environments)
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills, especially in written outreach
  • Experience with outbound prospecting and cold outreach
  • Familiarity with CRM tools (e.g., HubSpot, Salesforce)
  • Ability to understand and communicate design, product, or tech-related concepts
  • Self-motivated, organized, and comfortable working remotely
  • English proficiency required (additional languages are a plus)


Nice to Have

  • Experience selling design, product, or digital services
  • Understanding of UI/UX design processes and product development
  • Experience working with early-stage startups or founders


Why Join Us?

At Foundey, you will work on high-impact projects for fast-growing SaaS and cybersecurity companies, helping shape the digital tools that protect and empower businesses worldwide. You’ll collaborate with talented designers and technologists, contribute to cutting-edge design solutions, and grow your career in a studio that values innovation, ownership, and excellence.

title: Business Development Representative
description:
WeMaster Trade is a rapidly scaling fintech company operating in the trading space, connecting traders, partners, and affiliates across global markets. We move fast, think big, and focus on results. Our mission is to build a powerful ecosystem of strategic partnerships that drive growth and create long-term value. We are seeking a strategic and relationship-driven Business Development Representative (BDR) to join our growing team. In this role, you will focus on identifying, developing, and managing high-value partnerships that drive sustainable growth. You will play a key role in expanding our network of partners, affiliates, and strategic collaborators across global markets.


Responsibilities:

• Identify and engage potential strategic partners, affiliates, and business opportunities aligned with our growth objectives.

• Develop and nurture long-term relationships with partners, acting as a trusted point of contact.

• Evaluate partnership opportunities and build proposals that align with mutual business goals.

• Collaborate with internal teams (sales, marketing, operations) to execute and optimize partnership strategies.

• Support onboarding of new partners, ensuring a smooth and successful integration into our platform.

• Monitor partner performance and identify opportunities to maximize value and revenue.

• Maintain accurate records of partnerships, communications, and pipeline activity in CRM systems.

• Analyze market trends, competitor activity, and emerging opportunities to support expansion strategies.


Qualifications:

• 1–3 years of experience in business development, partnerships, or account management roles.

• Strong communication skills in English (professional level).

• Strategic mindset with strong relationship-building and negotiation skills.

• Ability to manage multiple partnerships and priorities simultaneously.

• Experience using CRM tools (e.g., HubSpot, Salesforce).

• Analytical thinking with a focus on long-term growth and value creation.

• Experience in fintech, trading, brokerage, affiliate programs, or digital platforms is a strong advantage.


What We Offer:

• Opportunity to work on high-impact strategic initiatives

• Ongoing professional development and career growth

• Collaborative and international work environment

• Exposure to global markets and partnership ecosystems


Job Type : Full-Time / Remote

Salary : $800 USD/month + Commission

title: Virtual Executive Assistant
description:
Blue Dot , headquartered in São Paulo, is a leading company in the Contact Center and Business Process Outsourcing (BPO) segment, with over 10 years of international experience. Specialized in Staffing solutions for companies in the United States, we connect highly qualified talent in Brazil with global career opportunities.


Our operation is strategically located in one of the largest metropolitan areas in the world, allowing us to access a broad, diverse, and highly skilled workforce.


Value Package for the Professional


  • Compensation: R$ 3,500.00
  • Structured career plan: real opportunities for growth into leadership positions
  • Professional stability: permanent position with a long-term focus
  • Continuous development: regular technical and behavioral training
  • Multicultural and dynamic environment with international exposure


Mandatory Requirements


  • Fluent English (C1 or C2 level, both spoken and written) – will be assessed during the process
  • Clear, professional, and objective communication skills
  • Strong organizational skills, productivity focus, and multitasking ability
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite
  • Familiarity with CRM systems, project management tools, or automation tools
  • 1 year experience in related roles


General Job Information


  • Schedule: Monday to Friday, from 12:00 PM to 9:00 PM (Brasília time)
  • Employment type: Full-time
  • Work model: 100% remote


Key Responsibilities


You will act as a strategic remote support professional for our clients in the United States, focusing on operational efficiency, service excellence, and commercial support. Responsibilities include:


Executive and Administrative Support


  • Managing calendars, meetings, and appointments
  • Handling corporate emails and preparing executive reports
  • Supporting administrative routines


International Recruitment


  • Sourcing and screening candidates for U.S.-based roles
  • Conducting cold calls, interviews, and follow-ups
  • Scheduling interviews and onboarding processes
  • Updating and maintaining databases


Commercial Support

  • Prospecting and qualifying leads
  • Conducting market research and interacting via CRM, email, and LinkedIn
  • Assisting with sales reports and forecasts


Customer Experience (CX)

  • Providing support via phone, email, and chat
  • Efficiently resolving customer requests
  • Collecting feedback and supporting retention strategies


Project Management (PMO)

  • Assisting with timelines, meetings, and task delegation
  • Updating documents and tracking deliverables
  • Supporting social media, content creation, and data entry


Accounts Receivable (Finance)

  • Issuing and sending invoices
  • Monitoring payments and tracking outstanding balances
  • Assisting in preparing financial reports


Desired Profile

  • Analytical, resilient, and strategic mindset
  • Ability to adapt to different demands and industries
  • Interest in building a long-term international career


How to Apply


Submit your application and become part of a team committed to excellence, connecting professionals with leading companies in the international market.


If you are selected to move forward in the process, we will contact you via LinkedIn.

title: Senior Ruby on Rails Engineer
description:
About StayFi

StayFi combines IoT and marketing technology for the vacation rental industry (think Airbnb hosts). With our product, vacation rental managers can create a meshable WiFi guest network with a custom-branded WiFi login page that collects guest information. Our software lets them monitor their network remotely and integrates with their marketing tools to help them build relationships with their guests and grow their business.


Over the past 8 years, we’ve built our business from the ground up without the help of large investors. This means we’re growing a sustainable business and we run it independently. We’re a small team so each team member has a big impact on our product and business. And we’re creating tools that our customers truly love.


About You
  • You're a senior full stack Ruby on Rails developer with 7+ years of professional experience building and shipping production applications.
  • You're a product-minded engineer who takes ownership. You think beyond each task / ticket and consider the broader impact of your technical decisions on the business.
  • You write expressive, readable, and maintainable code and hold yourself and others to a high standard through thoughtful code reviews.
  • You have a strong command of Rails conventions but know when and how to diverge from them pragmatically.
  • You're comfortable navigating and improving legacy codebases, not just greenfield projects.
  • You're curious about IoT, WiFi, and building sophisticated 3rd party API integrations.

  • You're energized by working on a small team where your decisions carry real weight.


About the Role
  • Write full stack code using Ruby on Rails, PostgreSQL, Tailwind CSS, React and JavaScript, and deploy it via Heroku, Azure and AWS.
  • Take ownership of large, complex projects: from scoping and architecture through to delivery in close collaboration with the CTO.
  • Identify and address performance bottlenecks, technical debt, and architectural weaknesses proactively.
  • Build and maintain robust API integrations with 3rd party software providers.
  • Lead by example in pull request culture; writing clear descriptions, giving constructive feedback, and raising the bar for the whole team.

  • Contribute to engineering standards, tooling decisions, and best practices as a senior voice on the team.


Why Work at StayFi?
  • You'll work directly with the CTO and CEO on mission-critical projects with real ownership and autonomy.
  • Your experience and judgment will directly shape the technical direction of the product.
  • You'll have an outsized impact both within our company and across the vacation rental industry  in a way that's rarely possible at larger organizations.
  • As you continue to help our business grow, you can expect increases in your salary or hourly rate.

  • You'll gain visibility into the full lifecycle of a sustainable, founder-led business well beyond just writing code.

title: Infrastructure Engineer
description:
ITTConnect is seeking an Infrastructure Engineer to work remotely from anywhere in Brazil for a client in the US.


MUST BE fluent in English.


The Infrastructure Engineer is responsible for supporting and maintaining customer IT infrastructure within the Managed Services environment. This role focuses on resolving technical issues, supporting backend infrastructure systems, and collaborating with customer IT teams to deploy and maintain solutions. Infrastructure Engineers combine technical troubleshooting with proactive monitoring and documentation to ensure stable and secure client environments.


Key Responsibilities


  • Troubleshoot and resolve technical issues related to servers, virtualization, storage, and core infrastructure systems.
  • Serve as an escalation point for the IT Support team on complex infrastructure-related incidents.
  • Work directly with customers and their IT teams to support the deployment, configuration, and maintenance of infrastructure solutions.
  • Investigate alerts and system reports to proactively identify potential infrastructure issues and performance risks.
  • Follow established runbooks, procedures, and architectural documentation to resolve incidents.
  • Exercise sound technical judgment when diagnosing and resolving infrastructure issues that may not have predefined solutions.
  • Assist with the creation and maintenance of runbooks, diagrams, and infrastructure documentation.
  • Participate in system maintenance activities such as upgrades, patching, and system health checks.
  • Document incident resolution steps and system changes within internal ticketing and knowledge management systems.
  • Maintain strong communication with internal teams and customers regarding issue status and resolution timelines.



Requirements

  • 8+ years of IT experience.
  • MUST BE fluent in English.
  • 3–6 years of experience supporting IT infrastructure in an MSP, enterprise IT, or hosting environment.
  • Experience with Windows or Linux server administration.
  • Experience with virtualization platforms (VMware, Hyper-V, etc.).
  • Familiarity with storage, backup, and disaster recovery systems.
  • Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills.
  • Experience working within ticketing systems and following structured support processes.
  • Strong documentation and communication skills.

Preferred

  • Certifications such as VMware VCP, Microsoft, or cloud infrastructure certifications.
  • Experience working in a Managed Service Provider (MSP) environment with exposure to ITIL-based service delivery models.
  • Experience with enterprise infrastructure technologies including VMware vSphere, Cisco UCS, and Citrix Virtual Apps and Desktops (CVAD).
  • Cloud platform administration experience; Google Cloud Platform (GCP) and Amazon Web Services (AWS) are preferred.
  • Experience with cloud platforms, particularly Google Cloud Platform (GCP), including infrastructure design, administration, and troubleshooting.
  • Administration experience with Cisco Unified Communications Manager (CUCM), and enterprise storage platforms.
  • Familiarity with identity platforms (Active Directory, Okta), firewalls (Palo Alto, Cisco FTD), and backup/disaster recovery solutions is a plus.

title: Salesforce CRM Specialist
description:
Position Overview:

As the Customer Relationship Management Specialist (CRM Specialist), you will support the day-to-day execution of the CRM function. You will be a key contributor in Salesforce Marketing Cloud (SFMC), partnering with Marketing, Operations, Contact Center, and Product to build and optimize journeys, automations, and campaigns that move clients from inquiry to booked appointment to loyal advocate.

This role sits within the Marketing team, working alongside peers across demand generation, digital performance, brand, and content.


Key Responsibilities:


Salesforce Marketing Cloud (SFMC):

Support the execution and optimization of campaigns within SFMC. Collaborate on building, testing, and deploying journeys and automations with a strong focus on the end-user experience and business impact.

Client Journey:

Assist in building and improving omnichannel journeys across email and SMS, supporting key moments from lead to booking to post-visit engagement, including reminders and follow-ups.

Data Segmentation and Hygiene:

Maintain audience segments and support data quality initiatives, including contact organization, suppression lists, and basic scoring logic to ensure a reliable database.

Testing & Quality Control:

Execute A/B tests on subject lines, send times, messaging, and journey logic. Document results and apply learnings to improve performance.

Performance & Reporting:

Support CRM reporting by tracking key metrics such as bookings, conversion rates, and engagement. Contribute to performance analysis and insights.

Operational Support:

Work cross-functionally with Marketing, Contact Center, and Product teams to identify and help resolve friction points in the client journey.

Platform Integrations:

Support the day-to-day functioning of SFMC in coordination with Salesforce CRM and other tools. Escalate issues and collaborate on solutions when needed.


Required Qualifications:

Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, or a related field (or equivalent professional experience)

3–5 years of experience in CRM, lifecycle marketing, or marketing automation roles, including Salesforce Marketing Cloud



Preferred Qualifications:

Salesforce Marketing Cloud certification

Working knowledge of Salesforce CRM

Experience in multi-location services, retail, or health and wellness industries

Familiarity with booking or practice management systems

Experience with SMS marketing and omnichannel engagement

Basic understanding of Martech integrations and data structures

Experience creating or adapting content to improve engagement across the client lifecycle

title: Conversion Rate Optimization Manager
description:
*Native/Bilingual English is required for this role (read/written/spoken)


Please upload your CV Resume in English.


Monthly salary: $2,000 - $2,200 USD


Along with our partner, we are seeking a Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO) Manager who will drive revenue growth by optimizing conversion rates, improving user experience, and reducing friction across the customer journey on their Shopify storefront. You will oversee and execute A/B testing, user behavior analyses, funnel audits, and UX gap analyses. You will have the knowledge and experience to use CRO reports, experiment results, and dashboards to identify areas for optimization and will lead projects to implement those findings. You will conduct competitive research and deploy the latest developments in conversion rate optimization in partnership with their development and ecommerce teams.


Essential Functions

  • A/B Testing and Experimentation: Design, execute, and analyze A/B and multivariate tests across key pages and touchpoints. Prioritize experiments based on potential impact, traffic, and business goals to build a rigorous, data-driven testing roadmap.
  • On-Site Optimization: Optimize landing pages, product detail pages (PDPs), collection pages, cart, and checkout flows to maximize conversion. Collaborate with their ecommerce and design teams to ensure all pages are aligned with CRO best practices.
  • User Behavior Analysis: Leverage heatmaps, session recordings, funnel analytics, and user surveys to uncover friction points and opportunities. Translate qualitative and quantitative insights into actionable hypotheses.
  • Shopify & Development Collaboration: Partner closely with their development team to implement CRO changes on the Shopify platform. Ensure experiments and site updates are implemented accurately, QA tested, and deployed efficiently.
  • Funnel & Revenue Optimization: Identify and prioritize drop-off points across the customer journey from acquisition through post-purchase and develop initiatives to reduce abandonment, increase AOV, and improve repeat purchase rates.
  • Reporting and Analysis: Provide regular reports on CRO performance, experiment results, and KPIs using analytics and CRO tools. Communicate findings and recommendations clearly to stakeholders and leadership.
  • Other duties may be assigned


What you will bring / Qualifications

To perform this job successfully, you must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily.

The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required.

  • In-depth knowledge of CRO principles, UX best practices, and e-commerce conversion frameworks.
  • Strong understanding of A/B testing methodology, statistical significance, and experiment design.
  • Hands-on experience with Shopify or a comparable e-commerce platform; ability to collaborate effectively with development teams on implementation.
  • Proficiency in using CRO and analytics tools such as Google Analytics, heatmap tools, and experimentation platforms.
  • Ability to read, analyze, and interpret complex data sets, experiment results, and performance reports.
  • Ability to present findings and recommendations to cross-functional teams and leadership.
  • Ability to solve practical problems and apply structured experimentation methodology in ambiguous situations.
  • Ability to interpret quantitative and qualitative data to form clear, testable hypotheses.
  • Ability to calculate and interpret key metrics such as conversion rates, statistical significance, and revenue metrics.


Education and/or experience

  • Bachelor’s degree from a four-year college or university, or equivalent experience as a CRO specialist or analyst in e-commerce.
  • 3–5 years of experience managing a CRO program or cross-functional optimization team.


Core competencies

  • Action Oriented: Taking on new opportunities and challenges with urgency and energy.
  • Resourcefulness: Securing and deploying resources effectively.
  • Collaboration: Building partnerships and working collaboratively with others.
  • Self-Development: Actively seeking growth opportunities.
  • Strategic Thinking: Identifying opportunities and adapting to trends.
  • Technical Proficiency & Problem Solving: Using tools and data to drive solutions.
  • Communication: Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Results-driven: Focused on measurable, data-driven outcomes.


Benefits

  • A fully remote position with a structured schedule that supports work-life balance.
  • The opportunity to drive measurable revenue growth by optimizing user experience and conversion performance.
  • Two weeks of paid vacation per year.
  • 10 paid days for local holidays.


*Please note our partner is only looking for full-time dedicated team members who are eager to fully integrate within their team.

title: Firewall Engineer
description:
We’re Hiring: Firewall Engineer (L3 Support – F5 Technologies)


We are looking for a skilled Firewall Engineer to provide L3-level support from a nearshore location in Latin America, with a strong focus on F5 technologies . This role involves operational support, configuration, troubleshooting, and optimization of F5 devices and related security infrastructure.


Key Responsibilities

• Manage and support F5 BIG-IP platforms (LTM, GTM/DNS, ASM, APM as applicable)

• Perform L3 troubleshooting for application delivery, load balancing, and firewall-related issues

• Implement configuration changes, policy updates, and SSL certificate management

• Analyze traffic flows and security events to ensure optimal performance and protection

• Participate in incident response and root-cause analysis for F5-related issues

• Support automation or scripting tasks for configuration consistency (e.g., Python, iControl REST)

• Maintain documentation for configurations, standards, and operational procedures

• Collaborate with network and security teams to support enterprise-wide initiatives


✅ Required Skills

• Strong hands-on experience with F5 BIG-IP modules

• Deep understanding of L4–L7 traffic flows, TCP/IP, and application delivery

• Ability to troubleshoot complex issues independently at an L3 level

• Experience working in remote/nearshore support models


If you’re ready to take on complex challenges in a dynamic environment, we’d love to hear from you!

title: Full Stack Web Developer
description:
Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.


Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparencia, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?


Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.


Nosso Cliente

Esta oportunidade irá atender um de nossos clientes globais do segmento de óleo e gás, com atuação em projetos estratégicos e de grande escala, em um ambiente altamente tecnológico e com interação internacional.

Oportunidade para atuar com desenvolvimento Full Stack em aplicações modernas, envolvendo arquitetura escalável, desenvolvimento e evolução de aplicações web e atuação em ambientes cloud.


O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho

  • Desenvolver e manter aplicações web full stack (frontend e backend)
  • Construir e consumir APIs REST utilizando .NET (C#)
  • Desenvolver interfaces responsivas com Angular e/ou Vue.js
  • Atuar com deploy e gestão de aplicações em cloud (Azure e/ou AWS)
  • Trabalhar com pipelines de CI/CD e versionamento com Git
  • Aplicar boas práticas de desenvolvimento (clean code, testes, design patterns)
  • Colaborar com times multidisciplinares em ambiente ágil

Dependendo do projeto, você também poderá atuar com:

  • Integração de APIs
  • Containerização com Docker
  • Infraestrutura como código (Terraform)



O que você precisa ter

  • Experiência como Full Stack Web Developer em ambiente produtivo
  • Sólidos conhecimentos em C# e .NET (APIs REST)
  • Experiência com Angular (TypeScript) e/ou Vue.js / AngularJS
  • Experiência com cloud (Azure ou AWS)
  • Vivência com Git e boas práticas de desenvolvimento
  • Conhecimentos em HTML, CSS e JavaScript
  • Inglês avançado para comunicação com times globais



Será um destaque seu perfil com:

  • Experiência com arquitetura de sistemas escaláveis
  • Vivência com CI/CD (build, testes e deploy)
  • Experiência com Docker (containerização)
  • Conhecimento em Terraform ou outras ferramentas de IaC
  • Experiência com manutenção e evolução de aplicações


Onde você vai trabalhar?

No conforto da sua casa. Regime 100% Home Office

title: Pessoa Executiva de Vendas Pleno
description:
A Knewin é a maior empresa de tecnologia e inteligência de dados da América Latina, com 15 anos de mercado, mais de 200 pessoas e presença consolidada no ecossistema de comunicação, marketing e inteligência de mercado. Desenvolvemos soluções de tecnologia que empoderam marcas, de assessorias de imprensa e agências de relações públicas a grandes empresas e governos.

Somos uma empresa em forte expansão, com três rodadas de capital de risco realizadas (Oria Capital), cultura ágil e um time que acredita que tecnologia e pessoas transformam negócios de verdade.


Estamos buscando um(a) Executivo(a) de Vendas para atuar no segmento Mid Market e Enterprise , com perfil híbrido : capaz de fechar novos negócios com leads gerados pelo Marketing, desenvolver prospecção ativa (outbound) e explorar oportunidades de Upsell e Cross-sell dentro da base de clientes existente.

Essa é uma vaga para quem tem mentalidade de crescimento, visão de negócio e sabe construir relações consultivas com decisores de comunicação e marketing em empresas de médio e grande porte.

Vaga 100% remota - Home Office


Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Atuar no ciclo completo de vendas: da qualificação ao fechamento, com contas Mid Market e Enterprise;
  • Trabalhar leads qualificados gerados pelo Marketing (inbound), com foco em conversão eficiente;
  • Executar prospecção outbound ativa, mapeando contas estratégicas, personalizando abordagens e gerando pipeline próprio;
  • Identificar e desenvolver oportunidades de Upsell e Cross-sell dentro da base de clientes atual, em parceria com o time de Customer Success;
  • Conduzir apresentações e demos consultivas das soluções Knewin, adaptando o discurso ao contexto e às dores de cada cliente;
  • Construir e manter relacionamento sólido com múltiplos stakeholders (comunicação, marketing, C-level);
  • Mapear o processo decisório do cliente e influenciar cada etapa do funil;
  • Manter o CRM (HubSpot) atualizado com precisão e disciplina, garantindo previsibilidade de pipeline;
  • Elaborar propostas comerciais personalizadas e conduzir negociações complexas;
  • Colaborar ativamente com Marketing, CS e RevOps para otimizar conversão e reduzir churn.


Requisitos e qualificações

  • Experiência comprovada em vendas B2B SaaS, com ciclos de venda consultivos e tickets médios/altos;
  • Experiência com contas Mid Market ou Enterprise;
  • Histórico de atuação híbrida: capacidade tanto de converter inbound quanto de gerar pipeline outbound;
  • Experiência com vendas consultivas;
  • Excelente comunicação verbal e escrita, com habilidade real de se comunicar com decisores;
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de CRM, HubSpot é diferencial;
  • Ensino superior completo.


Também é legal se você tiver:

  • Vivência em ambientes de scale-up e/ou startups em crescimento acelerado ou empresas de tecnologia;
  • Familiaridade com HubSpot.
  • Carteira ou relacionamento com profissionais de Comunicação e Marketing em empresas de médio/grande porte;
  • Experiência com ferramentas de prospecção e automação (ex: Apollo, Lusha, LinkedIn Sales Navigator);
  • Conhecimento do ecossistema de agências de PR e assessorias de imprensa;


O que oferecemos:

  • Trabalho 100% remoto - Home Office;
  • Política de remuneração variável agressiva - com comissionamento competitivo e upside real atrelado à sua performance;
  • Pacote de benefícios Knewin;
  • Produto consolidado com cases relevantes no mercado;
  • Time comercial estruturado com suporte de Marketing, RevOps e CS;
  • Ambiente dinâmico, flexível e com autonomia real;
  • Oportunidade de crescimento em uma empresa em fase de expansão acelerada.

title: Senior Software Engineer, Platform Reliability
description:
Job Title: Senior Software Engineer, Platform Reliability

Location: Remote- LATAM


We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer with 5+ years of experience in platform reliability, backend systems, and cloud infrastructure. This role focuses on improving the reliability, scalability, and performance of a large-scale consumer video streaming platform.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Design and enhance highly reliable, scalable, and self-healing systems
  • Build and maintain observability (monitoring, logging, tracing, alerting)
  • Collaborate with engineering teams to improve system performance and architecture
  • Define and maintain SLAs/SLOs for backend services
  • Troubleshoot production issues and drive long-term solutions
  • Act as SME for platform reliability across streaming systems

Required Skills:

title: Chief Revenue Officer
description:
Chief Revenue Officer


The Opportunity


We're looking for a seasoned Chief Revenue Officer to help our client — an AI-powered logistics SaaS company — build and scale their US enterprise revenue engine from the ground up.


Our client is a Houston-based, seed-funded logistics platform founded in 2019. They bring consumer-app simplicity to enterprise logistics, unifying appointment scheduling, dock and yard management, and gate digitization for shippers, 3PLs, and carriers.


They've built real product-market traction and are now ready to scale. That's where you come in.


The Role


Reporting directly to the CEO, you'll own the entire US enterprise revenue motion end-to-end — strategy, hiring, pipeline, forecasting, and expansion. This is a rare \"own the whole thing\" seat: you'll set GTM strategy, build the team, and personally drive early pipeline until that team is in place.


What You'll Do


  • Build and execute the US enterprise GTM strategy from scratch
  • Hire, onboard, and lead the full revenue organization — AEs, BDRs, and sales management
  • Personally carry and close strategic early enterprise deals while the team ramps
  • Own pipeline generation, forecasting, and revenue operations
  • Partner with the CEO on pricing, packaging, and market positioning
  • Establish the sales culture, process, and playbook for a company scaling from near-zero to multi-million in ARR



What We're Looking For


Required:


  • 15–20 years of revenue leadership experience at the CRO level
  • Demonstrated track record scaling revenue from near-zero to multi-million within US enterprise
  • Proven experience hiring, building, and leading revenue teams (AEs, BDRs, sales managers) — not a solo operator with a CRO title
  • Deep logistics or supply chain industry experience
  • Native-level English and executive-level presence
  • Willingness to provide 2–3 references from prior employers


You'll thrive in this role if you:


  • Have reference-able revenue numbers you can point to from prior companies
  • Are energized by building from scratch rather than managing a mature org
  • Can toggle fluidly between strategy, recruiting, and rolling up your sleeves to close deals
  • Have operated inside or sold into US enterprise logistics, freight, or supply chain


This is not the right fit if you:

  • Come from a mid-market or non-logistics SaaS background
  • Have primarily tactical experience (AE, sales manager) without true org leadership
  • Lead with CRM/pipeline theater rather than produced revenue
  • Have never built or managed a revenue team
