title: Product Owner - Sênior
description:
Product Owner - Sênior

A jornada de quem ama repensar o futuro está aqui.


Sobre a Rethink

Somos uma consultoria que une tecnologia, design e estratégia de produtos digitais para solucionar os desafios de grandes empresas brasileiras. Agora como parte da Framework Digital , ampliamos nosso impacto atuando de ponta a ponta na jornada digital, da concepção à escala.


Nossa missão é gerar valor real por meio de soluções que conectam times, sistemas e pessoas. Acreditamos que a transformação digital acontece quando estratégia, tecnologia e experiência andam juntas e é isso que entregamos.


Empresas como Smiles, Gol, Santander Esfera, Swift e Comgás confiam em nossa parceria para acelerar sua evolução digital com consistência e resultado.

Diversidade e Inclusão

Para repensar o futuro, é essencial garantir ambientes mais diversos e inclusivos . Por isso, incentivamos fortemente a candidatura de mulheres, pessoas pretas, pardas, indígenas, LGBTQIAPN+ e pessoas com deficiência .

Que tal repensar um futuro mais diverso com a gente?

Qual será o seu papel?

No seu dia a dia, você gerenciará o backlog do produto, priorizando funcionalidades com base no valor para o negócio, impacto operacional e necessidades regulatórias. Atuará como principal interlocutor entre as áreas de negócio (operações, comercial, regulatório, supply chain) e os times de desenvolvimento, traduzindo necessidades de negócio em requisitos técnicos claros e viáveis. Você liderará cerimônias ágeis e garantirá a entrega contínua de valor, promovendo melhorias incrementais nos processos de distribuição de gás. Além disso, acompanhará métricas de desempenho do produto (KPIs de negócio e de uso), proporá evoluções baseadas em dados e feedback dos usuários, e garantirá que as soluções desenvolvidas estejam em conformidade com as normas de segurança e regulação do setor de gás.


Como será seu dia a dia?

  • Gerenciar o backlog do produto, priorizando funcionalidades com base no valor para o negócio, impacto operacional e necessidades regulatórias.
  • Atuar como principal interlocutor(a) entre áreas de negócio (operações, comercial, regulatório e supply chain) e os times de desenvolvimento, traduzindo necessidades em requisitos técnicos claros e viáveis.
  • Liderar cerimônias ágeis e garantir a entrega contínua de valor para o produto.
  • Promover melhorias incrementais nos processos de distribuição de gás.
  • Acompanhar métricas de desempenho (KPIs de negócio e de uso), analisando dados para direcionar evoluções do produto.
  • Propor melhorias com base em dados e feedbacks dos usuários.
  • Garantir que as soluções estejam em conformidade com normas de segurança e regulação do setor.


Para esta vaga, é essencial:

  • Visão holística e estratégica, com capacidade de compreender o negócio de distribuição de gás de ponta a ponta, conectando iniciativas de tecnologia às metas do negócio.
  • Perfil de liderança com forte viés de execução, sendo “mão na massa”, orientado(a) a resultados e capaz de remover impedimentos para garantir entregas com qualidade e agilidade.
  • Excelente comunicação e habilidade de transitar entre áreas, atuando como ponte entre negócio e tecnologia.
  • Sólido conhecimento em metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban, SAFe) e práticas de gestão de produto (roadmaps, OKRs, MVPs).
  • Experiência na liderança de squads multidisciplinares e atuação em ciclos de discovery e delivery.
  • Formação superior em Administração, Engenharia, Ciência da Computação ou áreas correlatas.


Você pode se destacar se:

  • Possuir pós-graduação ou MBA em Gestão de Negócios, Energia ou Transformação Digital.
  • Tiver certificações em Product Ownership (CSPO, PSPO) e metodologias ágeis (CSM, SAFe).
  • Tiver familiaridade com o setor de gás e energia, incluindo regulação da ANP e processos como medição, faturamento, logística e segurança operacional.
  • Demonstrar forte visão sistêmica e pensamento crítico.
  • Apresentar habilidade de negociação e influência.
  • Ser resiliente e adaptável em ambientes de alta complexidade.
  • Ter perfil colaborativo e facilitador.
  • Demonstrar orientação a resultados e senso de urgência.
  • Possuir experiência em contextos dinâmicos.

Curtiu a oportunidade?

Então, vem repensar o futuro com a gente! ✨

title: Founder Success Advisor | Growth Success Manager
description:
Founder Success Advisor (Customer Success | Coaching | Growth) | Remote

100% Remote | International Opportunity


About the Company

We are a fast-growing company in the creator economy & digital growth space, helping entrepreneurs scale their businesses through personal branding, content strategy, and monetization systems.


We support founders in building predictable and scalable growth engines through:

  • Landing pages & funnels
  • Social media (YouTube, LinkedIn, Instagram, X)
  • Lead generation systems
  • Content strategy & newsletters
  • Offer creation & monetization
  • Automation & AI workflows


About the Role

We’re looking for a Founder Success Advisor (FSA) to manage and grow a portfolio of founders inside a high-performance program. This is not a traditional Customer Success role. You’ll act as a:

  • Strategic advisor
  • Coach & accountability partner
  • Community leader
  • Revenue driver (retention + upsell)


You’ll ensure founders stay engaged, hit milestones, and achieve measurable ROI .


Key Responsibilities

  • Lead group coaching calls and community sessions
  • Manage a portfolio of founders with 1:1 follow-ups
  • Drive engagement inside community platforms (Skool)
  • Track progress, identify risks, and proactively solve issues
  • Review calls and surface insights to leadership
  • Generate testimonials, case studies, and reviews
  • Identify and close upsell opportunities

title: Analista de Operações de Crédito Imobiliário Sr
description:
Sobre a Volpi

Esqueça a burocracia dos bancões: a Volpi é a fintech que resolve. Simplificamos o financiamento imobiliário para deixar tudo 100% digital e infinitas vezes mais rápido. Trazemos décadas de experiência para transformar processos complexos em soluções ágeis, antecipando problemas e soluções. Tornamos a análise de crédito inteligente, feita sob medida para cada história. Com tecnologia proprietária construímos a solução completa, guiada por especialistas.


O desafio

Você fará parte do time responsável pela formalização e emissão de contratos de crédito imobiliário , garantindo qualidade de informação, organização e agilidade em um contexto de alto volume de demandas e múltiplas interfaces (jurídico, comercial, clientes e parceiros externos).

Mais do que executar, o desafio é organizar, padronizar e evoluir o processo de formalização , reduzindo dependências manuais, aumentando eficiência e contribuindo com melhorias contínuas, em parceria com as áreas de Produto e Tecnologia.

Hoje, os principais desafios incluem:

  • Alto volume de contratos com necessidade de agilidade na emissão
  • Dependência de validações manuais

O que esperamos de você:

  • Atuar na emissão e conferência de contratos com alto nível de atenção a detalhes

title: AI Software Engineer (Full-Stack)
description:
Sobre a posição


Estamos buscando um(a) Engenheiro(a) de Software Full-Stack Sênior para atuar no desenvolvimento de produtos que combinam infraestrutura crítica com Inteligência Artificial, em um ambiente onde segurança, escala e performance não são negociáveis.

Você vai liderar o ciclo completo de desenvolvimento, do desenho de interfaces à arquitetura de backend, com integração direta a soluções de IA. Se você tem visão de produto, autonomia técnica e pensa em sistemas antes de pensar em código, queremos conversar.


Principais responsabilidades


  • Liderar o ciclo completo de desenvolvimento full-stack: desde interfaces até backend, integrações com modelos de IA e monitoramento em produção;

  • Ser referência técnica no time, contribuindo para a disseminação do desenvolvimento assistido por IA.


Competências técnicas

  • Experiência prática em desenvolvimento assistido por IA, com uso de ferramentas como Cursor, GitHub Copilot ou Replit;
  • Domínio de ecossistemas de IA: LLMs, Prompt Engineering, RAG, LangChain ou Llama Index;
  • Experiência com APIs escaláveis, microsserviços e sistemas distribuídos com containers (Docker) e orquestração;

Há mais de 20 anos, a UPX protege ambientes digitais que não podem falhar. Somos uma empresa norte-americana de cibersegurança que já protegeu mais de 1.000 organizações nos setores financeiro, telecomunicações, cloud, mídia e streaming, jurídico e saúde e que confiam na UPX para manter suas operações no ar 24/7/365.

title: Cloud AI/ML Engineer
description:
Looking for an experienced Senior Cloud AI/ML Engineer to lead the automation of complex financial workflows at Prosigliere.


Description

We are seeking a Senior Cloud AI/ML Engineer with a \"cloud-first\" mindset to join our growing team. In this role, you won't just build models; you will architect end-to-end intelligent systems that redefine how we handle financial data. You will be responsible for analyzing manual credit request processes and identifying opportunities to automate them using cutting-edge cloud AI services.

The ideal candidate bridges the gap between raw data and actionable business intelligence, building tools that ingest high-stakes data from credit agencies, analyze it through sophisticated AI pipelines, and present it via human-in-the-loop dashboards. You will work closely with engineering leadership to turn manual bottlenecks into scalable, automated cloud solutions.


Responsibilities

  • Process Architecture: Analyze existing credit request workflows to identify automation opportunities using cloud-native AI/ML solutions.
  • Intelligent Data Ingestion: Design and implement processes utilizing Document Intelligence (OCR/Form parsing), and Web Search integration to gather and structure fragmented data.
  • Third-Party Data Synthesis: Build tools to ingest and analyze complex results from credit agencies (e.g., D&B, Experian, Equifax ) to drive automated decision-making.
  • Custom Tooling: Develop custom software bridges to fill gaps between standard cloud AI services and specific business requirements.
  • Human-in-the-Loop Systems: Create intuitive dashboards that visualize AI-driven analysis, allowing human reviewers to audit and approve automated recommendations.
  • Cloud Deployment: Deploy and maintain robust MLOps pipelines in a cloud environment, ensuring high reliability and security for sensitive financial data.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Communicate technical AI concepts to non-technical stakeholders and collaborate with backend teams to ensure seamless data flow.


Technology Requirements

  • 5+ years of experience in software engineering with a heavy focus on Cloud AI/ML implementations.
  • Cloud-First Expertise: Proven experience with Vertex AI (GCP) , Azure AI , or AWS SageMaker , specifically utilizing high-level AI services (Document AI, Search/Discovery, etc.).
  • Data Integration: Proficiency in building API integrations and data pipelines that handle structured and unstructured data from external financial vendors.
  • Python Mastery: Expert-level Python skills, including experience with LangChain, LlamaIndex, or similar frameworks for building agentic AI workflows.
  • Visualization: Experience building data dashboards using tools like Streamlit, Looker, or custom React-based frontend components.
  • Security Mindset: Deep understanding of handling sensitive PII (Personally Identifiable Information) within cloud environments.


Profile Requirements

  • Solution Architect Mentality: Ability to look at a manual business process and map it to a technical AI roadmap.
  • Independent Problem Solver: A self-starter who can build \"the bridge\" when a standard out-of-the-box tool doesn't exist.
  • Strong Communication: Ability to explain why an AI made a specific recommendation to stakeholders.
  • Agile Learner: A commitment to staying current with the rapid pace of LLM, RAG, and Agentic AI developments.
  • AI Tooling: Proficiency with AI-first engineering approaches and tooling is a plus. If you are familiar with the Cognition platform with Windsurf and Devin, that is even better.
  • Certifications: Google, Azure or AWS Cloud AI certifications are a big plus!

description:
B2B Appointment Setter - Uncapped Income (Base + Pay Per Call)

This position is fully remote. We're specifically hiring from LATAM and you must be available to work EST business hours for real-time collaboration.


Apply Here (See Instructions Below)


(


The Opportunity: Why GP Socials


We're not just another content agency. We're a fully remote content growth partner managing 100,000+ followers and generating hundreds of thousands of monthly views for our B2B clients. Some of whom are making $8,000,000+ in annual revenue. Plus, we've tripled our own revenue in the last year.


Here's What Makes Us Different:


  • Proven Growth Track Record : We've 3x'd our business while maintaining quality - our clients' content actually generates leads and builds brands
  • ⚡ Small Team = Massive Growth Potential : Work directly with the founder, acquire skills rapidly, and shape the trajectory of a fast-scaling agency
  • Real Impact, Real Results : The calls you book directly fuel our growth and put you at the center of every new client we sign.


Your Mission (Should You Choose to Accept It):


You'll own the top of our sales pipeline - turning LinkedIn conversations and inbound leads into booked calls on Braden's calendar. This isn't about spray-and-pray outreach or copy-paste scripts. You'll build real conversations with B2B founders and marketers, qualify them fast, and hand off warm, ready-to-buy prospects. Every call you book is a shot at a high paying client for GP Socials.


The Role: B2B Appointment Setter

Core Responsibilities:


1. LinkedIn Outbound & Conversation Management

  • Run daily LinkedIn outreach to qualified B2B founders, marketers, and decision-makers
  • Use AI to personalize opening messages based on the prospect's content, company, and role (no generic blasts)
  • Manage 50-100+ active LinkedIn conversations at a time without dropping threads
  • Handle objections in DMs and move qualified prospects toward a booked call
  • Track every conversation in our CRM with clear status, notes, and next steps

2. Inbound Lead Follow-Up

  • Respond to inbound leads from our content, referrals, and marketing FAST
  • Qualify leads against our ICP (B2B businesses doing $1M-$10M in revenue)
  • Book discovery calls directly onto Braden's calendar
  • Send pre-call confirmations and reduce no-show rates with reminder sequences

3. Pipeline Hygiene & Reporting

  • Keep the CRM clean: accurate stages, follow-up tasks, and conversation history
  • Report daily on outreach sent, replies, booked calls, and show rates
  • Flag patterns in objections and reply data so we can sharpen our messaging
  • Follow written SOPs for outreach cadences, qualification, and handoff


Who You Are: Non-Negotiables & Must-Haves


Deal-Makers (You Need ALL of These):

  • ✅ B2B Agency or SaaS Setting Experience: I do not care about years worked. All I care about is if you have booked calls with B2B businesses
  • ✅ Writes Like a Human: You can write DMs that sound like a real person, not a bot. You understand tone, pacing, and how to earn a reply in 2-3 sentences.
  • ✅ Fluent Written English: Your written English is clean enough that founders in the US won't clock you as a non-native speaker over DM. (Spoken English is a plus, but writing is the non-negotiable.)
  • ✅ CRM Discipline: You don't forget follow-ups, you don't lose threads, and you can be trusted to keep the pipeline clean without reminders. I should be able to look in the CRM and understand everything
  • ✅ Availability: Available to work EST business hours (9am-5pm EST) Monday-Friday for real-time collaboration and inbound response.

Deal-Breakers (Any of These = Not a Fit):

  • ❌ No proven B2B setting experience 
  • ❌ Rely on copy-paste templates and mass-blast tactics
  • ❌ Written English that reads as broken, stiff, or obviously AI-generated
  • ❌ Can't show specific numbers (calls booked, show rate, deals closed-won) from a previous setting role
  • ❌ Unwilling to work EST hours or live inside a CRM all day
  • ❌ Looking for a passive role


You're Perfect If You:

  • Get fired up about finding the exact line that makes a cold prospect say \"yeah, let's talk\"
  • Think in reply rates, show rates, and close rates - not just messages sent
  • Treat DMs like a craft, not a grind
  • Have run setting for a B2B agency or SaaS before and can talk about what worked and what flopped


The Package: What's In It for You


Compensation:

  • Base: $1,500 USD/month
  • Performance Bonus: $50 USD per booked call that shows up to the discovery call
  • Our Target: 20+ booked calls per month (realistic earnings $2,500+/month, uncapped)
  • The more calls you book, the more we make and the more you make. No ceiling.


The Perks:

  • Fully remote - work from anywhere in LATAM with a laptop and stable internet
  • ⚡ Work directly with the founder - no sales manager layers, no bureaucracy
  • Rapid skill acquisition - you'll learn B2B sales, positioning, and pipeline management from the inside of a scaling agency

title: Remote Business Analyst - 57510
description:
bout Turing:

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems.

Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L


About the Role:

We are looking for a detail-oriented Business Analyst to support evaluation and annotation workflows focused on quality, accuracy, and structured reasoning. This role is ideal for someone who is comfortable working with digital tools, performing side-by-side evaluations, and providing clear, well-supported justifications based on fact-checking.


Responsibilities:

  • Perform side-by-side (SxS) evaluations on GHD, comparing outputs and assessing quality, accuracy, and relevance.
  • Conduct fact-checking to validate information and identify inconsistencies or inaccuracies.
  • Provide detailed, well-structured justifications to support evaluation decisions.
  • Follow established evaluation guidelines and quality standards consistently.
  • Use browser-based tools and extensions to support analysis and review tasks.
  • Execute simple command-line instructions when required to support evaluation workflows.
  • Document findings clearly and communicate insights to stakeholders when needed.


Requirements:

  • Solid comfort using a computer in a professional setting.
  • Experience working with browser extensions and online tools.
  • Ability to run basic command-line commands (no advanced programming required).
  • Strong analytical and critical thinking skills.
  • High attention to detail and ability to justify decisions clearly and objectively.
  • Comfortable working with evaluation frameworks, comparisons, and structured analysis.
  • Good written communication skills in English.


Nice to Have:

  • Previous experience with evaluation, annotation, QA, or audit-type work.
  • Familiarity with data quality, content evaluation, or model/output assessments.
  • Background in business analysis, operations, or process improvement.


Perks of Freelancing With Turing:

  • Competitive compensation based on experience and expertise.
  • Flexible working hours and a fully remote environment.
  • Opportunity to contribute to impactful research initiatives.
  • Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.


Offer Details:

  • Commitment Required: 30 hours per week minimum.
  • Engagement Type: Contractor/Freelancer (no medical or paid leave).
  • Time Overlap: Some overlap with UTC-8:00 (2–5 hrs/day) America/Los_Angeles.


Application Process:

  • Shortlisted candidates will be invited to complete an analytical challenge.
  • Once the assessment is cleared, you’re ready to start contributing!


After applying, you will receive an email with a login link. Please use that link to access the portal and complete your profile.


Know amazing talent? Refer them at turing.com/referrals, and earn money from your network.

title: Project Manager- operations (Remote Latam)
description:
Role Summary

As Avanto scales our 300-person workforce, the efficiency of our internal operations is critical. We are seeking a highly structured, assertive Project Manager to drive our internal strategic initiatives across Operations, HR, and cross-functional departments.

We are continuously advancing how we operate through automation and emerging AI capabilities, and this role plays a key part in driving those efficiencies across the organization.

This role is the antidote to \"scope creep\" and undocumented meetings. We need a driver who can step into ambiguous strategic discussions, extract the concrete deliverables, define the scope, and relentlessly manage the execution. While you will not be managing client deployments or writing software code, you will act as the crucial link between our operational leaders and our internal systems/support teams. You will ensure that before we implement a new workflow or build a new internal tool, the business requirements are meticulously documented and agreed upon.

Key Responsibilities

Scope Capture & Definition

  • Own the Meeting Outcome: Attend internal strategy and planning meetings to act as the definitive owner of project scope. Ensure no meeting ends without documented consensus on exactly what is being executed, who owns it, and the timeline.
  • Translate Strategy to Action: Take high-level concepts from operations and HR leaders and distill them into strict, clear, and executable project plans.
  • Prevent Scope Creep: Act as the gatekeeper for internal initiatives, ensuring that any additions to a project's scope are properly vetted, documented, and given updated timelines.

Operations & Systems Liaison

  • Define Business Requirements: Partner with Operations to map out current workflows, identify bottlenecks, and document clear business requirements for new tools or processes.
  • Guide Systems Implementation: Manage the rollout of both off-the-shelf operational solutions and custom-built internal tools.
  • Support Internal Builders: Ensure that our internal development/systems support teams are only handed fully scoped, approved, and documented business requirements, preventing ad-hoc interruptions and misaligned builds.

Internal Project Leadership & Execution

  • Drive Cross-Functional Delivery: Manage complex internal initiatives—such as operational restructuring, HR program launches, or new system integrations—from inception to completion.
  • Hold Stakeholders Accountable: Competently and confidently follow up with internal stakeholders at all levels (including Directors and VPs) to ensure tasks and dependencies are completed on time.
  • Maintain the Source of Truth: Build and maintain comprehensive project boards and dashboards (using Jira, Notion, etc.) so leadership has real-time visibility into internal project health.

Required Skills & Competencies

  • Assertive Stakeholder Management: You are not afraid to hold department heads accountable to their deadlines. You can lead laterally without formal reporting authority.
  • Exceptional Scope Discipline: A proven track record of taking ambiguous business conversations and locking them down into clear, documented project scopes.
  • Business Process Mapping: You naturally see how to organize chaos into a step-by-step workflow and can clearly articulate how an operation should function.
  • Tool Mastery: Expert-level proficiency in project management and documentation tools like Jira, Notion, Asana, or Monday.com
  • Communication: Direct, clear, and highly organized written and verbal communication.
  • Experience leveraging automation or AI tools to improve workflows is preferred

Experience & Qualifications

  • Experience: 3–6 years of project management experience, with a heavy emphasis on internal operations, process improvement, or business systems implementation.
  • Cross-Departmental Exposure: Proven experience running projects that span multiple internal departments (e.g., HR, IT, Operations).
  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Operations, Project Management, or a related field.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

  • Internal Delivery Rate: Percentage of internal operational projects delivered within planned timelines.
  • Scope Fidelity: Accuracy of initial project documentation and the minimization of undocumented post-kickoff changes.
  • Process Adoption: Successful rollout and sustained adoption of new internal workflows and operational systems.


Salary: $1,500-2,000 monthly USD

title: Project Manager- operations (Remote Latam)
description:
Role Summary

As Avanto scales our 300-person workforce, the efficiency of our internal operations is critical. We are seeking a highly structured, assertive Project Manager to drive our internal strategic initiatives across Operations, HR, and cross-functional departments.

We are continuously advancing how we operate through automation and emerging AI capabilities, and this role plays a key part in driving those efficiencies across the organization.

This role is the antidote to \"scope creep\" and undocumented meetings. We need a driver who can step into ambiguous strategic discussions, extract the concrete deliverables, define the scope, and relentlessly manage the execution. While you will not be managing client deployments or writing software code, you will act as the crucial link between our operational leaders and our internal systems/support teams. You will ensure that before we implement a new workflow or build a new internal tool, the business requirements are meticulously documented and agreed upon.

Key Responsibilities

Scope Capture & Definition

  • Own the Meeting Outcome: Attend internal strategy and planning meetings to act as the definitive owner of project scope. Ensure no meeting ends without documented consensus on exactly what is being executed, who owns it, and the timeline.
  • Translate Strategy to Action: Take high-level concepts from operations and HR leaders and distill them into strict, clear, and executable project plans.
  • Prevent Scope Creep: Act as the gatekeeper for internal initiatives, ensuring that any additions to a project's scope are properly vetted, documented, and given updated timelines.

Operations & Systems Liaison

  • Define Business Requirements: Partner with Operations to map out current workflows, identify bottlenecks, and document clear business requirements for new tools or processes.
  • Guide Systems Implementation: Manage the rollout of both off-the-shelf operational solutions and custom-built internal tools.
  • Support Internal Builders: Ensure that our internal development/systems support teams are only handed fully scoped, approved, and documented business requirements, preventing ad-hoc interruptions and misaligned builds.

Internal Project Leadership & Execution

  • Drive Cross-Functional Delivery: Manage complex internal initiatives—such as operational restructuring, HR program launches, or new system integrations—from inception to completion.
  • Hold Stakeholders Accountable: Competently and confidently follow up with internal stakeholders at all levels (including Directors and VPs) to ensure tasks and dependencies are completed on time.
  • Maintain the Source of Truth: Build and maintain comprehensive project boards and dashboards (using Jira, Notion, etc.) so leadership has real-time visibility into internal project health.

Required Skills & Competencies

  • Assertive Stakeholder Management: You are not afraid to hold department heads accountable to their deadlines. You can lead laterally without formal reporting authority.
  • Exceptional Scope Discipline: A proven track record of taking ambiguous business conversations and locking them down into clear, documented project scopes.
  • Business Process Mapping: You naturally see how to organize chaos into a step-by-step workflow and can clearly articulate how an operation should function.
  • Tool Mastery: Expert-level proficiency in project management and documentation tools like Jira, Notion, Asana, or Monday.com
  • Communication: Direct, clear, and highly organized written and verbal communication.
  • Experience leveraging automation or AI tools to improve workflows is preferred

Experience & Qualifications

  • Experience: 3–6 years of project management experience, with a heavy emphasis on internal operations, process improvement, or business systems implementation.
  • Cross-Departmental Exposure: Proven experience running projects that span multiple internal departments (e.g., HR, IT, Operations).
  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Operations, Project Management, or a related field.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

  • Internal Delivery Rate: Percentage of internal operational projects delivered within planned timelines.
  • Scope Fidelity: Accuracy of initial project documentation and the minimization of undocumented post-kickoff changes.
  • Process Adoption: Successful rollout and sustained adoption of new internal workflows and operational systems.


Salary: $1,500-2,000 monthly USD

description:

Role Overview

Our client is seeking a Senior QA Automation Engineer  to lead the transition from manual regression testing to fully automated execution in CI/CD. This is a hands-on role with clear ownership: build, stabilize, and run automated regression suites using Katalon Studio , fully integrated into Azure DevOps pipelines .

You’ll work across two enterprise web applications built with Angular (front end)  and C#/.NET (back end) , hosted in AWS and Azure . The expectation is not just writing tests, but owning execution reliability, test data strategy, and automation standards while mentoring a manual QA team.

Test Design & Stability

Test Data & Environments

Mentorship & Standards

Reporting & Metrics

Required Qualifications

  • 3–5+ years of QA Automation Engineering  experience

  • Experience automating Angular web applications

Preferred Experience

What Success Looks Like

  • Automated regression suites running reliably on every deployment
  • Reduced manual regression effort and release risk

  • Clear visibility into automation health and coverage

Essa posição é ideal para quem tem paixão por resolver desafios complexos de engenharia, otimizar sistemas de alta performance e construir soluções robustas, escaláveis e seguras.


Atividades

  • Projetar e implementar soluções baseadas em Machine Learning e LLMs  para detecção de fraudes e ameaças, incluindo classificação de eventos, detecção de anomalias, enriquecimento de dados e automação de decisões.
  • Incorporar modelos preditivos aos pipelines de processamento, garantindo baixa latência, escalabilidade e aderência aos requisitos operacionais do ambiente antifraude.
  • Monitorar performance, drift e eficácia dos modelos, realizando ajustes contínuos em features, regras e estratégias.
  • Liderar o desenvolvimento ponta a ponta de componentes críticos e funcionalidades de alto impacto nos sistemas antifraude.
  • Identificar e resolver gargalos de performance, otimizando processamento de dados em Python e queries complexas em PostgreSQL e Oracle.
  • Projetar, desenvolver e manter APIs REST robustas, seguras e de baixa latência utilizando FastAPI e Flask.
  • Atuar como referência técnica no código, garantindo boas práticas, qualidade arquitetural e manutenibilidade das soluções.
  • Colaborar com equipes de frontend, produto e dados para construção de soluções integradas e eficazes.
  • Mentorar desenvolvedores(as) por meio de code reviews, pair programming e disseminação de conhecimento técnico.
  • Criar e manter documentação técnica clara sobre APIs, componentes e padrões de desenvolvimento.
  • Garantir a evolução contínua da base de código e a excelência técnica dos sistemas desenvolvidos.


Requisitos

  • Experiência mínima de 8 anos em desenvolvimento de software , com foco em sistemas backend robustos e escaláveis.
  • Domínio avançado em Python , incluindo programação assíncrona (async/await) e uso de frameworks como FastAPI e Flask.
  • Experiência sólida em desenvolvimento de APIs REST  e arquitetura de microsserviços.
  • Forte conhecimento em bancos de dados, modelagem e otimização de queries SQL.
  • Experiência prática com PostgreSQL e/ou Oracle , incluindo análise de planos de execução.
  • Conhecimento em Machine Learning e LLMs  aplicados a problemas reais.
  • Experiência com TypeScript e React , com capacidade de colaborar com o time de frontend.
  • Vivência com Docker, CI/CD  e práticas de DevOps.


Competências

  • Pensamento analítico e forte capacidade de resolução de problemas complexos.
  • Perfil hands-on, com senso de dono e foco em resultado.
  • Boa comunicação e colaboração entre áreas técnicas e de negócio.
  • Capacidade de atuar como referência técnica e mentorar equipes.
  • Organização e compromisso com qualidade e performance.
  • Proatividade na proposição de soluções inovadoras.

title: Ecommerce Email/SMS Retention Marketing Specialist
description:
Just as a disclaimer, please don't use AI or ChatGPT during the screening or interview process. We use a screening tool that can detect AI in your answers and during interviews. Using AI will result in your application being immediately disqualified.


About Apex Brands:

We are a DTC Growth Marketing Company focused on helping service businesses grow profitably.


Our Values:

- Treat others the way we want to be treated.

- Pay close attention to detail.

- Don't neglect the small things, they matter.

- Think critically and be a problem solver, not a problem creator.

- Have the confidence and determination to achieve our shared vision.


Who We Are Looking For:

We're looking for an experienced, self-sufficient Email & SMS Marketing Specialist who can fully own the strategy, copy, design, and execution of retention campaigns across multiple accounts.


Role Overview:

We're looking for a full-stack lifecycle marketer—someone who can strategize, write, design, and execute high-performing email and SMS campaigns end-to-end. You’ll be the go-to expert responsible for delivering results across Klaviyo, Postscript, and other tools, and will manage the full lifecycle marketing function for several eCommerce brands.


What You’ll Do:

  • Own Campaign Creation and Client Calendar Planning From A–Z : Develop a campaign calendar for brands assigned to you and execute email and SMS campaigns including strategy, segmentation, copywriting, design layout, scheduling, and testing.


  • Build Automations & Flows: Set up and maintain high-converting flows such as Welcome, Abandon Cart, Browse Abandonment, Winback, Post-Purchase, etc.


  • Design Beautiful, On-Brand Emails: Use Figma or another editor of your choice (or custom code if needed) to design emails that look great on mobile and desktop—and convert.


  • Write Strategic, On-Brand Copy: Craft subject lines, preview text, and body copy that aligns with the brand voice and drives action.


  • Run A/B Tests & Optimize: Continuously test and refine subject lines, send times, content blocks, and CTAs to improve performance.


  • Audience Segmentation & List Growth: Manage lists and build smart segments to personalize messaging and improve deliverability.


  • Analytics & Reporting: Monitor and report on key KPIs (open rate, click rate, CVR, unsubscribes, revenue per recipient, etc.) and use insights to inform future strategy.


  • Client Communication: Hop on strategy calls or send Looms explaining performance, roadmap, and ideas to clients.


Who You Are:

  • Fluent verbal and written English copywriting skills


  • An experience retention & lifecycle marketer who can handle everything from strategy, copy, design, build, test, and optimize.


  • 3+ years of experience in email/SMS marketing for eCommerce brands


  • Fluent in Klaviyo and at least one major SMS platform (Postscript, Attentive, etc.)


  • Strong portfolio showing high-performing campaigns (with clear results)


  • Excellent design eye—clean layouts, great typography, conversion-focused styling


  • Strong copywriting skills—can write clear, engaging, persuasive emails for a variety of brand voices


  • Ability to manage multiple clients and timelines without dropping the ball


  • Agency experience preferred


  • Bonus: HTML/CSS familiarity for custom email tweaks


Why Work With Us:

  • Work with top-tier 8 & 9 figure DTC brands


  • Flexible remote work schedule


  • Clear systems and team support, but lots of autonomy


  • Direct impact on performance and client growth


  • Growth potential into leadership or strategy roles


Compensation:

  • $1500 - $6000 USD per month


To be considered for this role please apply and follow/connect with our CEO (Andrew Giessinger):

Diferenciais

A jornada de quem ama repensar o futuro está aqui.


Sobre a Rethink

Somos uma consultoria que une tecnologia, design e estratégia de produtos digitais para solucionar os desafios de grandes empresas brasileiras. Agora como parte da Framework Digital , ampliamos nosso impacto atuando de ponta a ponta na jornada digital, da concepção à escala.


Nossa missão é gerar valor real por meio de soluções que conectam times, sistemas e pessoas. Acreditamos que a transformação digital acontece quando estratégia, tecnologia e experiência andam juntas e é isso que entregamos.


Empresas como Smiles, Gol, Santander Esfera, Swift e Comgás confiam em nossa parceria para acelerar sua evolução digital com consistência e resultado.

Que tal repensar um futuro mais diverso com a gente?

Qual será o seu papel?

No seu dia a dia, você gerenciará o backlog do produto, priorizando funcionalidades com base no valor para o negócio, impacto operacional e necessidades regulatórias. Atuará como principal interlocutor entre as áreas de negócio (operações, comercial, regulatório, supply chain) e os times de desenvolvimento, traduzindo necessidades de negócio em requisitos técnicos claros e viáveis. Além disso, acompanhará métricas de desempenho do produto (KPIs de negócio e de uso), proporá evoluções baseadas em dados e feedback dos usuários, e garantirá que as soluções desenvolvidas estejam em conformidade com as normas de segurança e regulação do setor de gás.


Como será seu dia a dia?

  • Gerenciar o backlog do produto, priorizando funcionalidades com base no valor para o negócio, impacto operacional e necessidades regulatórias.
  • Atuar como principal interlocutor(a) entre áreas de negócio (operações, comercial, regulatório e supply chain) e os times de desenvolvimento, traduzindo necessidades em requisitos técnicos claros e viáveis.
  • Liderar cerimônias ágeis e garantir a entrega contínua de valor para o produto.
  • Promover melhorias incrementais nos processos de distribuição de gás.
  • Acompanhar métricas de desempenho (KPIs de negócio e de uso), analisando dados para direcionar evoluções do produto.
  • Propor melhorias com base em dados e feedbacks dos usuários.
  • Garantir que as soluções estejam em conformidade com normas de segurança e regulação do setor.


Para esta vaga, é essencial:

  • Visão holística e estratégica, com capacidade de compreender o negócio de distribuição de gás de ponta a ponta, conectando iniciativas de tecnologia às metas do negócio.
  • Perfil de liderança com forte viés de execução, sendo “mão na massa”, orientado(a) a resultados e capaz de remover impedimentos para garantir entregas com qualidade e agilidade.
  • Excelente comunicação e habilidade de transitar entre áreas, atuando como ponte entre negócio e tecnologia.
  • Sólido conhecimento em metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban, SAFe) e práticas de gestão de produto (roadmaps, OKRs, MVPs).
  • Experiência na liderança de squads multidisciplinares e atuação em ciclos de discovery e delivery.
  • Formação superior em Administração, Engenharia, Ciência da Computação ou áreas correlatas.


Você pode se destacar se:

  • Possuir pós-graduação ou MBA em Gestão de Negócios, Energia ou Transformação Digital.
  • Tiver certificações em Product Ownership (CSPO, PSPO) e metodologias ágeis (CSM, SAFe).
  • Tiver familiaridade com o setor de gás e energia, incluindo regulação da ANP e processos como medição, faturamento, logística e segurança operacional.
  • Demonstrar forte visão sistêmica e pensamento crítico.
  • Apresentar habilidade de negociação e influência.
  • Ser resiliente e adaptável em ambientes de alta complexidade.
  • Ter perfil colaborativo e facilitador.
  • Demonstrar orientação a resultados e senso de urgência.
  • Possuir experiência em contextos dinâmicos.

Curtiu a oportunidade?

Então, vem repensar o futuro com a gente! ✨

description:

(


The Opportunity: Why GP Socials


We're not just another content agency. We're a fully remote content growth partner managing 100,000+ followers and generating hundreds of thousands of monthly views for our B2B clients. Some of whom are making $8,000,000+ in annual revenue. Plus, we've tripled our own revenue in the last year.

  • Proven Growth Track Record : We've 3x'd our business while maintaining quality - our clients' content actually generates leads and builds brands
  • ⚡ Small Team = Massive Growth Potential : Work directly with the founder, acquire skills rapidly, and shape the trajectory of a fast-scaling agency
  • Real Impact, Real Results : The calls you book directly fuel our growth and put you at the center of every new client we sign.


Your Mission (Should You Choose to Accept It):


You'll own the top of our sales pipeline - turning LinkedIn conversations and inbound leads into booked calls on Braden's calendar. This isn't about spray-and-pray outreach or copy-paste scripts. You'll build real conversations with B2B founders and marketers, qualify them fast, and hand off warm, ready-to-buy prospects. Every call you book is a shot at a high paying client for GP Socials.


The Role: B2B Appointment Setter

Core Responsibilities:


1. LinkedIn Outbound & Conversation Management

  • Run daily LinkedIn outreach to qualified B2B founders, marketers, and decision-makers
  • Use AI to personalize opening messages based on the prospect's content, company, and role (no generic blasts)
  • Manage 50-100+ active LinkedIn conversations at a time without dropping threads
  • Handle objections in DMs and move qualified prospects toward a booked call
  • Track every conversation in our CRM with clear status, notes, and next steps

2. Inbound Lead Follow-Up

  • Respond to inbound leads from our content, referrals, and marketing FAST
  • Qualify leads against our ICP (B2B businesses doing $1M-$10M in revenue)
  • Book discovery calls directly onto Braden's calendar
  • Send pre-call confirmations and reduce no-show rates with reminder sequences

3. Pipeline Hygiene & Reporting

  • Keep the CRM clean: accurate stages, follow-up tasks, and conversation history
  • Report daily on outreach sent, replies, booked calls, and show rates
  • Flag patterns in objections and reply data so we can sharpen our messaging
  • Follow written SOPs for outreach cadences, qualification, and handoff


Who You Are: Non-Negotiables & Must-Haves


Deal-Makers (You Need ALL of These):

  • ✅ B2B Agency or SaaS Setting Experience: I do not care about years worked. All I care about is if you have booked calls with B2B businesses
  • ✅ Writes Like a Human: You can write DMs that sound like a real person, not a bot. You understand tone, pacing, and how to earn a reply in 2-3 sentences.
  • ✅ Fluent Written English: Your written English is clean enough that founders in the US won't clock you as a non-native speaker over DM. (Spoken English is a plus, but writing is the non-negotiable.)
  • ✅ CRM Discipline: You don't forget follow-ups, you don't lose threads, and you can be trusted to keep the pipeline clean without reminders. I should be able to look in the CRM and understand everything
  • ✅ Availability: Available to work EST business hours (9am-5pm EST) Monday-Friday for real-time collaboration and inbound response.

Deal-Breakers (Any of These = Not a Fit):

  • ❌ No proven B2B setting experience 
  • ❌ Rely on copy-paste templates and mass-blast tactics
  • ❌ Written English that reads as broken, stiff, or obviously AI-generated
  • ❌ Can't show specific numbers (calls booked, show rate, deals closed-won) from a previous setting role
  • ❌ Unwilling to work EST hours or live inside a CRM all day
  • ❌ Looking for a passive role


You're Perfect If You:

  • Get fired up about finding the exact line that makes a cold prospect say \"yeah, let's talk\"
  • Think in reply rates, show rates, and close rates - not just messages sent
  • Treat DMs like a craft, not a grind
  • Have run setting for a B2B agency or SaaS before and can talk about what worked and what flopped


The Package: What's In It for You


Compensation:

  • Base: $1,500 USD/month
  • Performance Bonus: $50 USD per booked call that shows up to the discovery call
  • Our Target: 20+ booked calls per month (realistic earnings $2,500+/month, uncapped)
  • The more calls you book, the more we make and the more you make. No ceiling.


The Perks:

  • Fully remote - work from anywhere in LATAM with a laptop and stable internet
  • ⚡ Work directly with the founder - no sales manager layers, no bureaucracy
  • Rapid skill acquisition - you'll learn B2B sales, positioning, and pipeline management from the inside of a scaling agency

title: Cloud AI/ML Engineer
description:
Looking for an experienced Senior Cloud AI/ML Engineer to lead the automation of complex financial workflows at Prosigliere.


Description

We are seeking a Senior Cloud AI/ML Engineer with a \"cloud-first\" mindset to join our growing team. In this role, you won't just build models; you will architect end-to-end intelligent systems that redefine how we handle financial data. You will be responsible for analyzing manual credit request processes and identifying opportunities to automate them using cutting-edge cloud AI services.

The ideal candidate bridges the gap between raw data and actionable business intelligence, building tools that ingest high-stakes data from credit agencies, analyze it through sophisticated AI pipelines, and present it via human-in-the-loop dashboards. You will work closely with engineering leadership to turn manual bottlenecks into scalable, automated cloud solutions.


Responsibilities

  • Process Architecture: Analyze existing credit request workflows to identify automation opportunities using cloud-native AI/ML solutions.
  • Intelligent Data Ingestion: Design and implement processes utilizing Document Intelligence (OCR/Form parsing), and Web Search integration to gather and structure fragmented data.
  • Third-Party Data Synthesis: Build tools to ingest and analyze complex results from credit agencies (e.g., D&B, Experian, Equifax ) to drive automated decision-making.
  • Custom Tooling: Develop custom software bridges to fill gaps between standard cloud AI services and specific business requirements.
  • Human-in-the-Loop Systems: Create intuitive dashboards that visualize AI-driven analysis, allowing human reviewers to audit and approve automated recommendations.
  • Cloud Deployment: Deploy and maintain robust MLOps pipelines in a cloud environment, ensuring high reliability and security for sensitive financial data.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Communicate technical AI concepts to non-technical stakeholders and collaborate with backend teams to ensure seamless data flow.


Technology Requirements

  • 5+ years of experience in software engineering with a heavy focus on Cloud AI/ML implementations.
  • Cloud-First Expertise: Proven experience with Vertex AI (GCP) , Azure AI , or AWS SageMaker , specifically utilizing high-level AI services (Document AI, Search/Discovery, etc.).
  • Data Integration: Proficiency in building API integrations and data pipelines that handle structured and unstructured data from external financial vendors.
  • Python Mastery: Expert-level Python skills, including experience with LangChain, LlamaIndex, or similar frameworks for building agentic AI workflows.
  • Visualization: Experience building data dashboards using tools like Streamlit, Looker, or custom React-based frontend components.
  • Security Mindset: Deep understanding of handling sensitive PII (Personally Identifiable Information) within cloud environments.


Profile Requirements

  • Solution Architect Mentality: Ability to look at a manual business process and map it to a technical AI roadmap.
  • Independent Problem Solver: A self-starter who can build \"the bridge\" when a standard out-of-the-box tool doesn't exist.
  • Strong Communication: Ability to explain why an AI made a specific recommendation to stakeholders.
  • Agile Learner: A commitment to staying current with the rapid pace of LLM, RAG, and Agentic AI developments.
  • AI Tooling: Proficiency with AI-first engineering approaches and tooling is a plus. If you are familiar with the Cognition platform with Windsurf and Devin, that is even better.
  • Certifications: Google, Azure or AWS Cloud AI certifications are a big plus!

title: U.S. Immigration Paralegal
description:
Goodcase.io ( is a legal technology company offering comprehensive support for immigration law firms. Beyond crafting documentation for visa applications including O-1, EB-1A, EB-2 NIW, H-1B, L-1, and E-2, we support firms with digital transformation, operations & growth consulting, and marketing - helping them scale efficiently without additional hiring.


We are looking for an experienced U.S. Immigration Paralegal to join our growing team and consistently deliver high-quality legal documents.


Responsibilities:

  • Draft complex and comprehensive documents for EB-1A, NIW, and O-1 petitions under supervision of the U.S. immigration attorney.
  • Analyze case strategy and supporting documentation provided by the attorney.
  • Conduct research to gather necessary details for documents and supplementary materials.
  • Ensure documents meet the highest standards, enabling immigration attorneys and case managers to finalize applications efficiently and accurately.
  • Adhere to strict deadlines to maintain case progress and prevent submission delays.
  • Consistently deliver high-quality work, reducing the need for revisions and improving the overall efficiency of the case management process.
  • Collaborate effectively with team leads and case managers to ensure smooth case progress.


Our requirements:

  • Proven experience with U.S. business immigration including EB-1A, EB-2 NIW, and O-1 petitions.
  • Excellent command of the English language.
  • Strong work ethic, attention to detail, and the ability to view client profiles holistically to effectively highlight their achievements for officers.
  • Ability to take an assignment from inception to completion with minimal supervision.
  • Strong organizational skills, ability to work under pressure, work with competing deadlines, and prioritize workload effectively.


We offer:

  • Competitive remuneration.
  • Remote work and flexible, task-oriented schedule.
  • A supportive, innovative, and international workplace with opportunities for growth and development.
  • We are looking for an independent contractor (B2B).

title: Project Manager- operations (Remote Latam)
description:
Role Summary

As Avanto scales our 300-person workforce, the efficiency of our internal operations is critical. We are seeking a highly structured, assertive Project Manager to drive our internal strategic initiatives across Operations, HR, and cross-functional departments.

We are continuously advancing how we operate through automation and emerging AI capabilities, and this role plays a key part in driving those efficiencies across the organization.

This role is the antidote to \"scope creep\" and undocumented meetings. We need a driver who can step into ambiguous strategic discussions, extract the concrete deliverables, define the scope, and relentlessly manage the execution. While you will not be managing client deployments or writing software code, you will act as the crucial link between our operational leaders and our internal systems/support teams. You will ensure that before we implement a new workflow or build a new internal tool, the business requirements are meticulously documented and agreed upon.

Key Responsibilities

Scope Capture & Definition

  • Own the Meeting Outcome: Attend internal strategy and planning meetings to act as the definitive owner of project scope. Ensure no meeting ends without documented consensus on exactly what is being executed, who owns it, and the timeline.
  • Translate Strategy to Action: Take high-level concepts from operations and HR leaders and distill them into strict, clear, and executable project plans.
  • Prevent Scope Creep: Act as the gatekeeper for internal initiatives, ensuring that any additions to a project's scope are properly vetted, documented, and given updated timelines.

Operations & Systems Liaison

  • Define Business Requirements: Partner with Operations to map out current workflows, identify bottlenecks, and document clear business requirements for new tools or processes.
  • Guide Systems Implementation: Manage the rollout of both off-the-shelf operational solutions and custom-built internal tools.
  • Support Internal Builders: Ensure that our internal development/systems support teams are only handed fully scoped, approved, and documented business requirements, preventing ad-hoc interruptions and misaligned builds.

Internal Project Leadership & Execution

  • Drive Cross-Functional Delivery: Manage complex internal initiatives—such as operational restructuring, HR program launches, or new system integrations—from inception to completion.
  • Hold Stakeholders Accountable: Competently and confidently follow up with internal stakeholders at all levels (including Directors and VPs) to ensure tasks and dependencies are completed on time.
  • Maintain the Source of Truth: Build and maintain comprehensive project boards and dashboards (using Jira, Notion, etc.) so leadership has real-time visibility into internal project health.

Required Skills & Competencies

  • Assertive Stakeholder Management: You are not afraid to hold department heads accountable to their deadlines. You can lead laterally without formal reporting authority.
  • Exceptional Scope Discipline: A proven track record of taking ambiguous business conversations and locking them down into clear, documented project scopes.
  • Business Process Mapping: You naturally see how to organize chaos into a step-by-step workflow and can clearly articulate how an operation should function.
  • Tool Mastery: Expert-level proficiency in project management and documentation tools like Jira, Notion, Asana, or Monday.com
  • Communication: Direct, clear, and highly organized written and verbal communication.
  • Experience leveraging automation or AI tools to improve workflows is preferred

Experience & Qualifications

  • Experience: 3–6 years of project management experience, with a heavy emphasis on internal operations, process improvement, or business systems implementation.
  • Cross-Departmental Exposure: Proven experience running projects that span multiple internal departments (e.g., HR, IT, Operations).
  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Operations, Project Management, or a related field.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

  • Internal Delivery Rate: Percentage of internal operational projects delivered within planned timelines.
  • Scope Fidelity: Accuracy of initial project documentation and the minimization of undocumented post-kickoff changes.
  • Process Adoption: Successful rollout and sustained adoption of new internal workflows and operational systems.


Salary: $1,500-2,000 monthly USD

  • Audience Segmentation & List Growth: Manage lists and build smart segments to personalize messaging and improve deliverability.

  • 3+ years of experience in email/SMS marketing for eCommerce brands

  • Strong portfolio showing high-performing campaigns (with clear results)


  • Excellent design eye—clean layouts, great typography, conversion-focused styling


  • Strong copywriting skills—can write clear, engaging, persuasive emails for a variety of brand voices


  • Ability to manage multiple clients and timelines without dropping the ball


  • Agency experience preferred


  • Bonus: HTML/CSS familiarity for custom email tweaks


Why Work With Us:

  • Work with top-tier 8 & 9 figure DTC brands


  • Flexible remote work schedule


  • Clear systems and team support, but lots of autonomy


  • Direct impact on performance and client growth


  • Growth potential into leadership or strategy roles


Compensation:

Location: Colombia, Brazil, Chile, Philippines, Vietnam, China

Employment: Remote | Contract / Consultant

Compensation: USD $1–40/hour (based on experience)

Duration: Open-ended


Role Summary

We are seeking a Senior Biostatistician Consultant to support clinical trial activities across global pharmaceutical and biotechnology projects. This role focuses on statistical leadership, study design, regulatory submissions, and collaboration with cross-functional clinical teams and CRO partners.


Key Responsibilities

  • Provide statistical expertise and support for clinical trial design and execution
  • Contribute to study protocol development, including:
  • Study design discussions
  • Sample size calculations
  • Develop and review:
  • Statistical Analysis Plans (SAPs)
  • Analysis datasets and TLG specifications
  • Review CRFs, edit checks, and data review guidelines
  • Perform statistical analyses and interpret results for clinical studies
  • Prepare clinical study reports (CSRs) and integrated summaries for regulatory submissions
  • Ensure compliance with FDA regulations, GCP, and CDISC standards
  • Support ADaM dataset specifications and QC activities
  • Review or author data transfer specifications from external vendors
  • Collaborate with CROs, vendors, and internal clinical teams to ensure deliverables meet timelines
  • Contribute to SOPs, work instructions, and statistical programming standards
  • Provide clear communication of statistical methodology to both technical and non-technical stakeholders


Required Qualifications

  • Master’s degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Biostatistics, or closely related quantitative field
  • PhD strongly preferred
  • Minimum 5+ years of clinical trial experience in the pharmaceutical or biotechnology industry (MANDATORY) Hospital, academic, or government experience does not qualify
  • Strong experience working with CROs strongly preferred
  • Solid knowledge of:
  • Clinical trial design and methodology
  • Sample size calculations
  • SAP development
  • CSR authoring and submission-ready outputs
  • Strong SAS programming skills (required)
  • Experience QCing efficacy/safety outputs
  • R programming is a plus
  • Strong understanding of CDISC standards (SDTM/ADaM)
  • Experience generating and QCing ADaM specifications and datasets
  • Oncology experience is a plus

title: AI Software Engineer (Full-Stack)
description:
Sobre a posição


Estamos buscando um(a) Engenheiro(a) de Software Full-Stack Sênior para atuar no desenvolvimento de produtos que combinam infraestrutura crítica com Inteligência Artificial, em um ambiente onde segurança, escala e performance não são negociáveis.

Você vai liderar o ciclo completo de desenvolvimento, do desenho de interfaces à arquitetura de backend, com integração direta a soluções de IA. Se você tem visão de produto, autonomia técnica e pensa em sistemas antes de pensar em código, queremos conversar.


Principais responsabilidades


  • Liderar o ciclo completo de desenvolvimento full-stack: desde interfaces até backend, integrações com modelos de IA e monitoramento em produção;
  • Definir arquitetura e fluxos de usuário utilizando ferramentas e agentes de IA como apoio à geração, testes e evolução de código;
  • Projetar arquiteturas escaláveis para uso intensivo de LLMs, com foco em performance, disponibilidade e experiência do usuário
  • Desenvolver e manter pipelines de CI/CD e MLOps para entrega contínua e segura de aplicações e modelos;
  • Garantir qualidade técnica por meio de revisões de código e aderência a boas práticas de engenharia e segurança da informação;
  • Ser referência técnica no time, contribuindo para a disseminação do desenvolvimento assistido por IA.


Competências técnicas


  • Sólida base em engenharia de software: algoritmos, design de sistemas e arquitetura full-stack independente de linguagem;
  • Experiência prática em desenvolvimento assistido por IA, com uso de ferramentas como Cursor, GitHub Copilot ou Replit;
  • Domínio de ecossistemas de IA: LLMs, Prompt Engineering, RAG, LangChain ou Llama Index;
  • Experiência com APIs escaláveis, microsserviços e sistemas distribuídos com containers (Docker) e orquestração;
  • Conhecimento em bancos de dados relacionais e NoSQL;
  • Capacidade de implementar testes automatizados ao longo do ciclo de vida do software;
  • Comunicação clara e capacidade de traduzir necessidades de negócio em soluções técnicas viáveis.


Conhecimentos desejáveis


  • Experiência com gestão ágil de produtos, incluindo priorização de backlog e alinhamento técnico-negócio;
  • Fluência em inglês;
  • Conhecimento em ética de IA, privacidade de dados (LGPD/GDPR) e mitigação de vieses em modelos.


Sobre a UPX


Há mais de 20 anos, a UPX protege ambientes digitais que não podem falhar. Somos uma empresa norte-americana de cibersegurança que já protegeu mais de 1.000 organizações nos setores financeiro, telecomunicações, cloud, mídia e streaming, jurídico e saúde e que confiam na UPX para manter suas operações no ar 24/7/365.


Nosso portfólio integra soluções em Serviços de Segurança Gerenciada AI-driven, Proteção de Borda, Proteção de Endpoints e Segurança de Agentes de IA.


Aqui você vai trabalhar com especialistas que operam em ambientes onde o erro tem consequências reais, onde problemas são complexos e o trabalho importa. Se você gosta de pensar no todo, não só na sua parte, você pensa como nós.


Acesse upx.com para saber mais.


Siga a UPX nas mídias sociais: Instagram BR | Instagram US | Threads BR | Threads US | TikTok (BR) | LinkedIn | YouTube | X | Reddit

title: Especialista de Software – Desenvolvimento Anti-Fraude
description:
A Dadoteca é uma empresa inovadora no setor de tecnologia, dedicada a fornecer soluções de alta qualidade para nossos clientes por meio de um ambiente de trabalho colaborativo que impulsiona o desenvolvimento profissional e a inovação.


Atuação Hibrida - SP, Morumbi - 2x na semana.


Buscamos uma pessoa Especialista de Software , que será a principal referência técnica e o(a) desenvolvedor(a) mais experiente em nossos sistemas de prevenção a fraudes e segurança cibernética. Essa posição é ideal para quem tem paixão por resolver desafios complexos de engenharia, otimizar sistemas de alta performance e construir soluções robustas, escaláveis e seguras.


Atividades

  • Projetar e implementar soluções baseadas em Machine Learning e LLMs  para detecção de fraudes e ameaças, incluindo classificação de eventos, detecção de anomalias, enriquecimento de dados e automação de decisões.
  • Incorporar modelos preditivos aos pipelines de processamento, garantindo baixa latência, escalabilidade e aderência aos requisitos operacionais do ambiente antifraude.
  • Monitorar performance, drift e eficácia dos modelos, realizando ajustes contínuos em features, regras e estratégias.
  • Liderar o desenvolvimento ponta a ponta de componentes críticos e funcionalidades de alto impacto nos sistemas antifraude.
  • Identificar e resolver gargalos de performance, otimizando processamento de dados em Python e queries complexas em PostgreSQL e Oracle.
  • Projetar, desenvolver e manter APIs REST robustas, seguras e de baixa latência utilizando FastAPI e Flask.
  • Atuar como referência técnica no código, garantindo boas práticas, qualidade arquitetural e manutenibilidade das soluções.
  • Colaborar com equipes de frontend, produto e dados para construção de soluções integradas e eficazes.
  • Mentorar desenvolvedores(as) por meio de code reviews, pair programming e disseminação de conhecimento técnico.
  • Criar e manter documentação técnica clara sobre APIs, componentes e padrões de desenvolvimento.
  • Garantir a evolução contínua da base de código e a excelência técnica dos sistemas desenvolvidos.


Requisitos

  • Experiência mínima de 8 anos em desenvolvimento de software , com foco em sistemas backend robustos e escaláveis.
  • Domínio avançado em Python , incluindo programação assíncrona (async/await) e uso de frameworks como FastAPI e Flask.
  • Experiência sólida em desenvolvimento de APIs REST  e arquitetura de microsserviços.
  • Forte conhecimento em bancos de dados, modelagem e otimização de queries SQL.
  • Experiência prática com PostgreSQL e/ou Oracle , incluindo análise de planos de execução.
  • Conhecimento em Machine Learning e LLMs  aplicados a problemas reais.
  • Experiência com TypeScript e React , com capacidade de colaborar com o time de frontend.
  • Vivência com Docker, CI/CD  e práticas de DevOps.


Competências

  • Pensamento analítico e forte capacidade de resolução de problemas complexos.
  • Perfil hands-on, com senso de dono e foco em resultado.
  • Boa comunicação e colaboração entre áreas técnicas e de negócio.
  • Capacidade de atuar como referência técnica e mentorar equipes.
  • Organização e compromisso com qualidade e performance.
  • Proatividade na proposição de soluções inovadoras.


Diferenciais

  • Experiência prévia em antifraude e cibersegurança .
  • Conhecimento em Redis  para caching e otimização de performance.
  • Experiência com bibliotecas de processamento de imagens e documentos (OpenCV, Pillow, PyMuPDF).
  • Vivência com ferramentas de observabilidade como Prometheus, Grafana e Elastic APM.
  • Experiência com sistemas críticos de alta escala e baixa latência.
  • Inglês técnico para leitura e escrita.

title: PPC Ads Manager | Remote | Part Time
description:
Company Description

A Hiring Group is dedicated to helping companies across industries find, retain, and motivate top talent at all professional levels. We focus on providing tailored staffing solutions, whether for startups, mid-level companies, or national organizations, to meet workforce needs and support business success. Our expertise spans various domains, including software development, marketing, customer service, administrative support, and executive leadership roles.


Job Title: PPC Ads Manager (US Market)

Type: Part-Time

Working Hours: 20 hours per week

Time Zone: U.S. Pacific Time (PST)

Location: Remote


About the Role

A Hiring Group is looking for a results-driven Part-Time PPC Ads Manager to support a U.S.-based business operating in the home services industry . This role is ideal for someone who is analytical, structured, and highly focused on turning ad spend into measurable business growth.

The ideal candidate has hands-on experience managing paid campaigns in the U.S. market, understands lead generation for service-based businesses, and is comfortable making fast, data-driven decisions while working within a part-time schedule.


Key Responsibilities

  • Own and optimize paid acquisition campaigns across Google Ads, Bing Ads, Facebook Ads, Display, and Retargeting
  • Manage paid marketing budgets with a strong focus on CAC, ROAS, lead quality, and overall performance
  • Monitor campaign performance daily and make fast, data-driven optimizations
  • Support lead flow and demand generation across multiple business units through paid channels
  • Maintain clear campaign structures by service, region, channel, budget, and revenue performance
  • Build and maintain dashboards and performance reports using tools such as Google Analytics and Power BI
  • Collaborate closely with internal stakeholders, including the General Manager, marketing leads, and related business units
  • Research market trends, demand shifts, and new optimization opportunities in the U.S. market


Requirements

  • Minimum 2+ years of hands-on experience in PPC or performance marketing
  • Strong experience with Google Ads, Facebook Business Manager, and Bing Ads
  • Solid analytical mindset with strong attention to detail
  • Ability to manage multiple campaigns and priorities effectively
  • Strong English communication skills, both written and spoken
  • Highly organized, proactive, and accountable
  • Experience in US - Market
  • Comfortable working 20 hours per week aligned with U.S. Pacific Time
  • Experience with lead generation for service-based businesses


Why This Role

  • High ownership and direct impact on business growth
  • Clear KPIs, structure, and expectations
  • Long-term collaboration opportunity with a U.S.-based client
  • Part-time setup

title: Cloud Security Engineer - Especialista
description:
Quem somos nós?


Somos um ecossistema de transformação digital que combina tecnologia e visão estratégica para escalar resultados e aumentar o valor entregue aos nossos clientes. Trabalhamos na construção de soluções inovadoras e disruptivas em mais de 300 projetos com grandes empresas nacionais de múltiplos segmentos.


Nosso propósito é impactar positivamente pessoas e negócios , exponencializando cada um para atingir seu máximo potencial. Respeitamos todas as diferenças e criamos um espaço aberto e livre para você ter autonomia, expor suas ideias, aprender com os erros, se conectar com outras pessoas e gerar mudanças ao seu redor .


Se você deseja estar em um ambiente colaborativo, desafiador e que incentiva você a sempre evoluir e ser o protagonista da sua história, aqui é o seu lugar!


Antes de avançarmos, é importante você saber que:

  • Contratação: CLT
  • Modelo de Trabalho: Remoto
  • Horário: das 9h às 12h e das 13h às 18h. A jornada é flexível conforme agendas e entregas.
  • Etapas do Processo: Composto por 3 a 4 etapas, com um tempo médio de até 03 dias úteis entre uma etapa e outra.
  • Meios de Comunicação: Utilizamos E-mail e WhatsApp. Certifique-se de que essas informações estejam corretas no momento de inscrição para evitar falhas na comunicação.


O que buscamos?


Estamos em busca de um(a) Especialista em Cibersegurança para integrar nosso movimento. Essa pessoa será referência técnica em segurança de aplicações e infraestrutura, atuando de forma estratégica e hands-on na proteção de ambientes digitais complexos — com foco em pipelines seguros, desenvolvimento seguro e ambientes multicloud.


Como será seu dia-a-dia?


  • Projetar e revisar arquiteturas seguras para aplicações web, APIs e sites, identificando vulnerabilidades e propondo melhorias estruturais.
  • Configurar, evoluir e automatizar pipelines CI/CD no GitLab com integração de ferramentas de segurança (SAST, DAST, SCA, secrets scanning), garantindo que segurança faça parte do fluxo de entrega.
  • Apoiar times de desenvolvimento na adoção de práticas de desenvolvimento seguro (Secure SDLC), conduzindo análises de código e orientações sobre boas práticas de segurança.
  • Criar automações para monitoramento, detecção de ameaças, resposta a incidentes e hardening de ambientes, reduzindo a superfície de ataque de forma contínua.
  • Atuar na segurança de infraestruturas multicloud (AWS, Azure e/ou GCP), incluindo IAM, gestão de segredos, redes e conformidade com políticas de segurança.
  • Colaborar com squads e stakeholders técnicos para disseminar cultura de segurança, participar de revisões de arquitetura e contribuir proativamente com soluções inovadoras.
  • Manter-se atualizado(a) sobre o cenário de ameaças, CVEs relevantes e novas tecnologias de segurança, trazendo insights para o time.


Para cumprir esse desafio, você precisa ter:


  • Experiência com threat modeling, revisão de arquitetura de apps e sites, e conhecimento de OWASP Top 10 e boas práticas de segurança em APIs REST/GraphQL.
  • Domínio avançado de GitLab CI/CD, com experiência em configurar stages de segurança (SAST, DAST, SCA, secrets detection) e integrar ferramentas como Trivy, Semgrep ou similares.
  • Conhecimento de práticas como code review com foco em segurança, análise de dependências vulneráveis, gestão de segredos e políticas de controle de acesso.
  • Capacidade de desenvolver scripts, playbooks e automações (Python, Bash ou similares) para triagem de alertas, resposta a incidentes e hardening de ambientes.
  • Experiência em ao menos um provedor (AWS, Azure ou GCP) com foco em IAM, segurança de redes, gestão de segredos (Vault, KMS) e conformidade (CIS Benchmarks, CSPM).
  • Familiaridade com OWASP ZAP, Burp Suite, Snyk, SonarQube, Checkov, Prowler ou equivalentes.


Você irá se destacar se:


  • Conhecimento de frameworks como NIST, ISO 27001 ou SOC 2.


O que oferecemos aos nossos Builders?


  • Auxílio Alimentação (VA/VR) no cartão Caju;
  • Auxílio Home-Office no cartão Caju;
  • Programa de Pontos Flexíveis em seu Caju - um valor fléxivel para você usar como você quiser;
  • Plano de Saúde Nacional Porto Seguro (Plano Prata com apartamento e sem coparticipação) com 50% da mensalidade custeada pela Builders;
  • Assistência Odontológica pela Porto Seguro (Plano Bronze) com 100% da mensalidade paga pela Builders;
  • Auxílio Creche para crianças de até 72 meses;
  • Auxílio à Saúde Mental - acesso ao aplicativo Vida+;
  • Auxílio à Saúde Física - acesso ao aplicativo Gympass;
  • Seguro de vida.


Todas as nossas vagas são inclusivas e abertas a pessoas de todas as identidades de gênero, orientações sexuais, idades, etnias, culturas, origens, crenças, deficiências e outras diversidades. Acreditamos que a pluralidade enriquece nosso time e promove um ambiente de trabalho mais inovador e colaborativo.

title: Project Manager- operations (Remote Latam)
description:
Role Summary

As Avanto scales our 300-person workforce, the efficiency of our internal operations is critical. We are seeking a highly structured, assertive Project Manager to drive our internal strategic initiatives across Operations, HR, and cross-functional departments.

We are continuously advancing how we operate through automation and emerging AI capabilities, and this role plays a key part in driving those efficiencies across the organization.

This role is the antidote to \"scope creep\" and undocumented meetings. We need a driver who can step into ambiguous strategic discussions, extract the concrete deliverables, define the scope, and relentlessly manage the execution. While you will not be managing client deployments or writing software code, you will act as the crucial link between our operational leaders and our internal systems/support teams. You will ensure that before we implement a new workflow or build a new internal tool, the business requirements are meticulously documented and agreed upon.

Key Responsibilities

Scope Capture & Definition

  • Own the Meeting Outcome: Attend internal strategy and planning meetings to act as the definitive owner of project scope. Ensure no meeting ends without documented consensus on exactly what is being executed, who owns it, and the timeline.
  • Translate Strategy to Action: Take high-level concepts from operations and HR leaders and distill them into strict, clear, and executable project plans.
  • Prevent Scope Creep: Act as the gatekeeper for internal initiatives, ensuring that any additions to a project's scope are properly vetted, documented, and given updated timelines.

Operations & Systems Liaison

  • Define Business Requirements: Partner with Operations to map out current workflows, identify bottlenecks, and document clear business requirements for new tools or processes.
  • Guide Systems Implementation: Manage the rollout of both off-the-shelf operational solutions and custom-built internal tools.
  • Support Internal Builders: Ensure that our internal development/systems support teams are only handed fully scoped, approved, and documented business requirements, preventing ad-hoc interruptions and misaligned builds.

Internal Project Leadership & Execution

  • Drive Cross-Functional Delivery: Manage complex internal initiatives—such as operational restructuring, HR program launches, or new system integrations—from inception to completion.
  • Hold Stakeholders Accountable: Competently and confidently follow up with internal stakeholders at all levels (including Directors and VPs) to ensure tasks and dependencies are completed on time.
  • Maintain the Source of Truth: Build and maintain comprehensive project boards and dashboards (using Jira, Notion, etc.) so leadership has real-time visibility into internal project health.

Required Skills & Competencies
